Gawk at some of the world's ugliest animals who owe their survival to the adaptations that made them so strange. A pudgy wolf eel, naked mole rat, and hideous sea lamprey may be superficially grotesque, but they're evolutionarily amazing.

Witness the tiny creatures that make us squirm while hiding admirable survival skills. From playing dead, removing a tail, or being able to lift objects 30 times their weight, these insects conquer the world with their amazing adaptations.

Before the challenge begins, the designers are asked to re-pick their teams. Then, in teams of two, the designers are tasked with making a prom dress out of duct tape. In addition to the Runway, they are also judged on their work by a group of high school students, whose votes factor into their final score. Two designers are eliminated.

Regrouping once again, the judges decide which designers they would like to see work together, and the teams are separated into two teams of four. The designers must make cohesive looks for the male dance troupe Thunder From Down Under. Not only must they execute menswear, but their designs must be able to “tear away” onstage as part of their performance.

In new teams of twos and threes, the designers make a ready-to-wear look for Lord and Taylor, inspired by their famous rose design. The winning design is manufactured and sold at Lord and Taylor for Spring 2013.

In pairs again, the designers use HP technology and inspiration drawn from the Guggenheim Museum to create two looks: one avant-garde and a second ready-to-wear piece. They are also able to design their fabric for this challenge.

After working in teams all season, the designers are relieved when they receive the news that they will now be working on their own. However, some of the eliminated designers return to act as assistants and help the competitors complete their look. For this challenge, the designers must make a Spring 2013 editorial look to be worn by actress Jordana Brewster and featured in Marie Claire.

The remaining designers are paired with new assistants and each sent to a European fashion capital: Paris, Barcelona, London, and Berlin. One unlucky designer stays in NYC. The designers must draw inspiration from their city, as well as purchase their materials there. Upon returning to NYC, they must create a look for the judges that will prove they have what it takes to design a collection for Fashion Week.

Weak and weary from their journey, the few designers left say goodbye to NYC and return to their respective hometowns to begin working on their final collections. Tim Gunn travels to visit the designers and assess their progress. In the end, all four remaining designers must present their three best pieces to the judging panel, as the judges are left to decide who will move on to show at Mercedes Benz Fashion Week.

It's the moment of truth for the remaining designers as they each present their final collections to an eager audience at Mercedes Benz Fashion Week. One designer is named the winner of Project Runway Season 11, and the rest are unfortunately out.

Dr. Kim wonders why Chairman Shin has so much confidence in him amidst all the controversy he's faced in his life. Chairman Shin returns the question to him, wondering if all these amazing doctors in the association would try to save his life with billions of dollars on the line. A fight breaks out just outside the operating room, with In Bum and Dong Joo leaving each other's faces bruised.

Yoon Wan is ready to get rid of Dr. Kim and has a new and much younger chairman in mind to head the foundation. Dr. Kim and Chairman Shin, on the other hand, talk about the operation and how to go about it. It seems like a mission impossible, but Dr. Kim's out to pull some strings to make his plan work.

As Dr. Kim starts Chairman Shin's operation, the audience outside the operating room watches out for any mistake Dr. Kim makes. A damaged aorta and a severe perforation patient splits In Bum and Dong Joo, making the operation which already was impossible even worse to handle. Gi Tae accidentally lets a nosy reporter into some confidential material.

Seong Jae calls Dr. Kim unexpectedly. He brings an opportunity to Dr. Kim's table, but there happens to be a catch. President Do brings in the news that the hospital is set to be closed. The future of Doldam is close to becoming a mere thought or dream after its doors are sure to be closed by the wrath of Yoon Wan. Dr. Kim this time around, is unable to interfere with the decision.

Dong Joo now asks why Dr. Kim pushed back his father's operation many years ago. Dr. Kim is left dazed and uncertain while they stand before the rest of the staff. The nosy journalist now starts interviewing more people outside the hospital to dig deeper for his juicy case on Doldam. With emotions about his past lingering around the hospital, Dong Joo continues on the cardiac operation that hits very close to his heart.

Dr. Kim and the rest of the staff make their way to the capital. Tonight, they put down their scalpels and medical gowns. They put on their best suits and bring in the physical evidence to dethrone the corrupt and unethical President Do. Yoon Wan tries to negotiate himself out of it, but Dr. Kim is not buying any of it. The press and cameras are on them when the injury of a lifetime takes place.

After breaking up with Joon Young, Song Ah continues with her entrance exam as if nothing happened. On the other hand, Joon Young feels very bad that he hurt Song Ah. At the funeral, when Song Ah tells Joon Young about her recital and her plans as a violinist, Joon Young asks her if he can be her accompanist.

While Joon Young continues to wait for Song Ah's answer, Joon Young, Jung Kyung, and Hyeon Ho perform together at Director Nah's commemoration concert. Later, Song Ah shares the news regarding her admission offer from the graduate school with Joon Young. As Song Ah listens attentively to Joon Young's piano performance at his recital, she realizes that her feelings toward Joon Young are solid and carefully opens up to him once again.

Police chief Xavier Quinn (Denzel Washington) investigates the gruesome murder of Donald Pater, one of the wealthiest residents on a Caribbean island. He was found decapitated in his Jacuzzi. programmes.d: Sonic outsmarts Coconuts, then stumbles into a Convention of Bounty Hunter Robots where Robotnik puts a price on his head. After Sonic defeats all the Robot Bounty Hunters, Robotnik creates Scratch and Grounder to be his S.S.S.S.S. Squad.

Sonic and Tails find an underground world of diamonds, but they are held captive there by a miserly Mole-Troll. When Robotnik comes to capture them, he accidently frees them from the Mole-Troll, who teams up with Sonic and Tails to defend his riches.

Sonic saves a damsel in distress, and falls in love with her, not knowing she's a robot built by Robotnik. But when she has a chance to trap him, she helps him escape, realizing she has fallen for him.

When Scratch and Grounder use Robotnik's new Slo-Mo Ray Gun to capture Sonic, Tails rescues him by reversing the gun and turning it on a tribe of friendly Tree Sloth People who become a high speed commando strike force against Robotnik.

Tails and other Mobius citizens are lured into Robotnik's robotic games of chance, and when they lose they're sent to slave labor camps. Sonic rescues Tails and the others by beating the house in games of chance at Robotnik's Casino.
In order to free Sketch Lampoon (a satirical comic book artist) from Robotnik's new high security prison, Sonic allows himself to be captured, then makes a high speed rescue and escape.

When Tails gets trapped in the "Warp of Confusion" (an Escher-like world of another dimension) by Robotnik's cousin, Dr. Warpnik, Sonic comes to the rescue and traps Robotnik and his badniks in the warp.

programmes.st: Close Encounter of the Sonic Kind
programmes.d: Sonic and Tails befriend a pair of aliens who crash land their spaceship on Mobius. Sonic has to avoid Robotnik's ULTRA-GRAVITIZER (sort of a hedgehog flypaper) to help fix their ship and blast-off back home.

Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

Bob and the gang have got a big job on - repairing some pipework in Farmer Pickles field. / Bob, Scoop & Muck have to make repairs to a tunnel. When they arrive on site, Bob sends Muck ahead into the tunnel with a load of bricks.

Sonic and The Freedom Fighters journey to Robotnik's underground air base in a mission to reprogram the launch data on Robotnik's fleet of Stealth-Bot aircraft. While attempting to reprogram the Stealth-Bot computer system.

During a mission to one of Robotnik's factories, Sally is taken prisoner by Robotnik and Snively, who construct a roboti-sized "Sally" clone, complete with Sally's personality, and mannerisms. The double tricks Sonic into rescuing "Sally".

Sonic and the Freedom Fighters journey to Robotnik's lab in hopes of deciphering his roboti-sizer system. While underground, Sonic spots his now roboti-sized Uncle Chuck aboard a Badlands bound mine-train and devises a plan for his rescue.

Strawberry is really touched when her girlfriends and the Berrykins volunteer to help her with the construction of her new marketplace, so when the girls suggest they take charge of designing Strawberry's dream-bedroom to go on the second story, of course Strawberry agrees. While construction is going on, the girls each show Strawberry their individual ideas for the bedroom.

With time running out before the Grand Opening celebration for the new Marketplace, Strawberry's friends get the idea to invite her favorite singer, superstar CHERRY JAM, to be the guest singer. The girls are blown away when their berryjuice cell phone gets a text message that Cherry accepts their invitation! Strawberry is touched by their surprise, but reminds them that now the town and Marketplace really have to shine!

Cherry Jam is so enjoying staying in Berry Bitty City, that she calls her managers in Big Bitty City and informs them that she is going to stay for a much needed vacation! Strawberry and the girls are thrilled that she will be with them for a little longer, and they do all they can to make their guest comfortable. But Cherry doesn't want to be treated like a guest  she wants to fit in and contribute to the community.

Berry Bitty City is holding its first city-wide talent show! Hearing that it's the music students of superstar Cherry Jam, a talent scout from Big Bitty City plans to show up. Strawberry and her friends excitedly anticipate her arrival.

Raspberry is discovered by a talent scout who wants her to move to Berry Big City and design a new line of Glitter fashions! She will be provided with her own studio, staff, publicity, commitments from big department stores-everything she needs to be a big fashion designing star! All her friends are thrilled for her. Only Cherry is a bit less enthusiastic about Raspberry's stardom, which Raspberry mistakenly interprets as jealousy.

With the summer almost over, Blueberry overhears Strawberry talking about a wonderful tropical island and believes her friend is going to surprise them all with a much needed vacation! Blueberry makes the other girls promise to keep the secret until Strawberry reveals the big surprise. Of course, even though they've promised to keep the secret, they can't help but try and suss out what the island's like from every little thing Strawberry does.

It's the last week of summer and Berry Bitty City is hopping with activity as the girls prepare for their tropical island vacation at Berry Breezy Bay Resort. But just as they're about to leave, bad news: the resort is closed for the season due to berry breezy weather. The girls are disappointed, but Orange isn't giving up. She says if they can't go to the tropical island, maybe they can bring the tropical island here!

With only a few days of summer left, the girls are about to enjoy their first vacation in their newly-created, tropical beach resort at Berry Bitty Lake, when who should descend upon them but Mavis Maraschino, the comically over-the-top "Entertainment Tonight"-style show host. Mavis has dumped her focus on fashions in favor of an even glitzier show called Lifestyles of the Berry Big Bitty Stars, and she wants her first segment to be about how pop superstar Cherry Jam spends her vacation.

On a beautiful winter's night, Blueberry reads the Baby Berrykins a story of what happened one winter in Berry Bitty City-a winter that almost wasn't. Just as everyone is ready for winter fun and fashions, a sudden warming melts the snow and ruins their plans. Improvising with snowmen made of shaved ice and cotton puffs, Strawberry and her friends play "Capture the Snowman's Carrot Nose." The Berrykins want to join in the fun, so the girls play against them, with Strawberry refereeing.

It's another windy winter day, and the postal bees are staying indoors-the wind is too strong for their berry bitty wings. "We don't know when the next mail will get through!" It's bad news for Blueberry, who has been anxiously awaiting the next installment of a Patty Persimmon Detective story. If only she could get to the post office in Berry Bitty Dale where her package is waiting!

It appears winter is finally coming to an end and Raspberry is planning a big fashion show to display her spring line. Her vision is to have the girls model her fashions in a parade past the town fountain. What she didn't realize is that the Berrykins are turning the fountain into a big water show. Every time the girls come to rehearse, they must comically dodge jets of fruit juice from the out-of-control fountain-the Berrykins are still working out the bugs.

Strawberry, Cherry and the girls form a new band, Strawberry and the Sweet Beats, and prepare to go on the road to perform at the Opening Ceremony of the Berry Big City Games! While master mechanic Berrykin Bruce turns Cherry's tour bus into the band's hotel-on-wheels, Strawberry and her friends pack for the big trip. But the rest of Berry Bitty City points out that someone needs to run the girls' businesses while they are gone.

Berrykins Ed and Earl report to Princess Berrykin and Strawberry that they are certain there is a monster in the berry patch! They saw something with many noses and many tails making weird noises in the bushes. But upon further investigation by Strawberry and her friends, it is discovered that friendly boy Huckleberry Pie was driving his pet-mobile of orphan dogs through the countryside, took a wrong turn and got stuck near Berry Bitty City.

Blueberry is disappointed in the girls' lack of enthusiasm for the Patti Persimmon mystery novels, her favorite book series. She finds herself missing the company of her fellow Persimmon fan Huckleberry, and thinks up a great way to get him to visit. She invites Huck to co-write a story with her to submit to an online mystery magazine.. Huck eagerly accepts and comes for a visit.

A U.S. colonel (Craig Stevens) and a paleontologist (William Hopper) track a huge praying mantis from the North Pole to Manhattan.

To assist with his work due to his failing eyesight, renowned biologist Dr. Alexander Thorkel invites two prominent scientists and a mineralogist to his hidden Amazon jungle laboratory. Thorkel remains evasive about the nature of his experiments, and after the team evaluates his bacteria slides, he orders them away. When they refuse, Thorkel and his servant trick them into a chamber where Thorkel shrinks them down to microscopic size, and they escape to the terrifying jungle.

The dashing, mysterious Count Dracula (Bela Lugosi), after hypnotizing a British soldier, Renfield (Dwight Frye), into his mindless slave, travels to London and takes up residence in an old castle. Soon Dracula begins to wreak havoc, sucking the blood of young women and turning them into vampires. When he sets his sights on Mina (Helen Chandler), the daughter of a prominent doctor, vampire-hunter Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan) is enlisted to put a stop to the count's never-ending bloodlust.

A man washes ashore in England after a shipwreck and is found by Mina Van Helsing (Jan Francis). The man introduces himself as Count Dracula (Frank Langella) of Transylvania, and proceeds to integrate himself into the lives of Mina and her friend Lucy Seward (Kate Nelligan). However, when Mina dies and her father, Prof. Van Helsing (Laurence Olivier), attributes her death to a vampire, evidence indicates that Count Dracula is the monster, and Lucy is his next target.

Soon after beginning work for Conde Dracula (Carlos Villarias), the clerk Renfield (Pablo Alvarez Rubio) learns that his employer is, in fact, a vampire who lives on human blood. Now under Dracula's spell, Renfield helps his master travel to London, where the vampire takes another victim (Carmen Guerrero). Dracula also has eyes on the lovely Eva (Lupita Tovar), but her fiancé, Juan Harker (Barry Norton), and a wise professor named Van Helsing (Eduardo Arozamena) seek to stop him.
An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

When a friendly polar bear is wrongly accused of vicious behavior,  Eliza goes to great lengths to keep him from being harmed and learns the value of sticking by a friend in times of trouble.
Eliza succumbs to peer pressure from a teenage elephant disrupting her closeness with Marianne on an overnight trip.
Eliza convinces a mother kangaroo that she can handle the responsibilities of babysitting. She quickly learns that this mischievous Joey is more than meets the eye.
Dog builds his own Monster Truck and drags Cat to Nearburg Square Garden to enter the Monster Truck Rally.    Lola convinces CatDog to make honey in their own backyard.
CatDog fight over lunch then grapple in the kitchen, sending flour, sugar, chocolate, fruit, all over the place.   CatDog inherit some land on the shores of beautiful Lake Wanamaker.
Clarissa discovers that real science can be really weird.  After interviewing a woman who supposedly spotted a U.F.O., Clarissa decides to get to the bottom of the U.F.O. phenomena herself.

Clarissa discovers that Woolcott Industries is still doing animal testing at the local plant. She is determined to write an editorial blasting them and, in addition, she and Sam stage a peaceful protest outside the plant.
When the gang looks for Halloween costumes in the Finster's basement, they find TP+KF carved on the wall. Chuckie is furious that Tommy might like Kimi and their friendship is put to the test.
When the comic book starring Chuckie's favorite superhero gets canceled, he is too depressed to help Tommy with his science fair project. The gang tries to find Chuckie a new hero to worship.

Rachel moves to another town and fearing the worst, Tommy braces for a long mourning period. This is cut short when he meets Anita. When Rachel turns up unexpectedly, Tommy finds himself between a rock and a hard place.
Kimi heads a petition to ban cell phones in school, but Angelica drives a wedge between the siblings by hoodwinking Chuckie into helping her petition against the ban.
When the gang's parents feel that they are spending too much time watching TV, they ban it from the house. How will the gang get by without their favorite programs?

Susie is discovered as a great singing talent by an agent who leads her to believe she's going to be the next teen superstar.
Lil strikes a blow for independence from a bewildered Phil. Chuckie takes a defiant stand against the mandatory President's Fitness Test.

It’s time again for the prank war at the Palm Woods, and this time it's kids versus adults as they battle for the honor of winning Lord Prankington’s Cup.

James continues his pursuit of Lucy and buys a motorcycle in order to impress her, but he doesn’t know how to drive it. Kendall teaches Jo how to drive stick-shift, and Carlos & Logan can’t relinquish a childhood treasure.
Logan brings Carlos along to the MCAT test as his good luck charm, but when Carlos somehow gets a higher score, Logan questions his plans to become a doctor.
The guys are pitched a kids cartoon show but instead do a video game to expand their brand. A mix-up while wearing motion capture suits puts them at the center of an extraterrestrial news story.
After being told that boy bands always split up after the third album, the guys compete to find solo “breakout” gigs before being left behind.
The boys are tired of sharing a ride and get money to buy a car, but all goes bananas when Drake buys an orangutan named Bobo instead.
Drake and Josh accidentally burn down their neighbor's tree house.   Their parents force the boys to rebuild the tree house and Drake and Josh plan to do it quickly.
Drake has taken advantage of Josh for the last time and Josh decides that he is done dealing with Drake.
After Bellview High nerd, Eric Blonnowitz accidentally punches Drake he finds a newfound world of fame, popularity and girls.
After Drake and Josh accidentally kill Megan's pet hamster, they ready themselves for her revenge that could come anywhere, anytime.

True is dragged into Max and Doris' relationship drama when she and Lulu let slip that Doris' new assistant librarian is a hunk.
True designs a red velvet jacket for Burt Burlington to wear in the Macy's parade, but ends up featured in the parade herself when she tries to retrieve it.
True makes a deal with the devil when she agrees to plot revenge with Pinky Turzo (Jennette McCurdy), after diva Kelsey fires them both from designing costumes for Ryan's school play.
To impress a wealthy girl, Kenan pretends that he too is wealthy.  All goes well until Kel wrecks the limo Kenan has rented for the evening.

A local radio station is sponsoring a contest.  The grand-prize--two courtside seats to a Chicago Bulls game.  All Kenan and Kel have to do is perform a stunt crazier, wackier, and more dangerous than all the other entrants.
When Kel accidentally destroys half of the school's yearbook photos, it's up to him and Kenan to rectify the problem. In a rare stroke of luck, Bill Bellamy happens to be in town that week.
Kel takes on a job at a donut shop.  It's not long before he's created a sensational new donut and not long after that, he ruins the store.

BTR is on tour with Victoria Justice and we go inside the guys’ bus to see the craziness that happens on board. When the guys get stuck in traffic, it is up to Victoria to keep the concert audience entertained until they arrive.

The guys gain access to Bill's massive south Florida stockpile; Mike falls for a century-old Royal Pioneer motorbike; the guys assemble a custom chopper in five minutes flat.
Mike falls for a one-of-a-kind vintage motorcycle sign; a man keeps his treasures in a creepy cabin in the woods; Danielle's unique company car drives her crazy.

The guys stop in at Sam and Stan's steelyard where they go on a high-speed golf cart tour of massive hangar and outbuildings; the team goes freestyling and comes across an old farm; the guys come across Greg, who claims he's a psychic picker.

Mike and Frank hit the road to California with a gleaming airstream trailer in tow; a man's jaw-dropping collection includes an entire village built from scratch; Mike and Frank get first crack at a lifetime collection.

A New York collector has filled a train station with vintage cars; the guys stop at a New Hampshire home with an interesting weathervane on the roof; auctioneer Paul's property is packed with treasures his father rescued from the trash.

The crew rescues a group of refugees, only to discover they have been subject to government experiments and are extremely unstable.
Beka's Uncle Sid runs for office in the New Commonwealth, but an assassination attempt causes the crew to act as his security.
When the Andromeda is attacked by space pirates, they are rescued by a long-lost spaceship from Earth.
The crew discovers that a rogue planet, Marduk, has been creating weapons of mass destruction.
A hitman by the name of the Leper is targeting the leaders of the New Commonwealth.
The Andromeda is haunted by a mysterious creature that comes aboard during a solar storm.

programmes.st: And Your Heart Will Fly Away
programmes.d: When a long lost love returns, Tyr disappears from the ship to protect her from an assassin.
Set in an alternate universe where Dylan died and Gaheris Rhade is trying to reform the Commonwealth.
The group that attacked the Andromeda during the first Commonwealth charter signing returns to wreak more havoc.
Trance runs through a number of different scenarios, trying to find one in which her crewmates don't die.
A "more powerful" Andromeda ship explodes due to likely sabotage, forcing Dylan's crew to save them.
Beka endangers both her crew and an entire planet when a former love shows up.

programmes.st: What Happens to a Rev Deferred?
programmes.d: The Andromeda receives a cry for help from Rev Bam.
After a Commonwealth planet is attacked by Pyrian pyroformers, Dylan is forced to fight to protect the new planet.
Dylan hears voices beckoning him to a planet of "fire and ice," so he pursues, even though it means crossing hostile Nietzschean-controlled space.
While caught in a battle between two Nietzschean prides, the crew captures a hostile who claims that his pride possesses a map of the slipstream.
A wrong turn after exiting a slipstream sends the Andromeda into the Prolon system. They rescue an escape pod from certain disaster, but the pride wants it back.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: D'Arby the Gambler, Part 2
programmes.d: After losing to D'Arby, Joseph and Polnareff have their souls taken. In order to have their souls returned, Jotaro shows off Star Platinum's powers before beginning a match with D'Arby, warning him that cheating won't work.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Hol Horse and Mondatta, Part 1
programmes.d: Hol Horse arrives at Cairo in order to pursue Jotaro and the others. He has joined forces with another partner and is after the lives of Jotaro and crew once more. What's more, his new partner is none other than Mondatta.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Hol Horse and Mondatta, Part 2
programmes.d: Following Mondatta's prediction, Hol Horse sticks his fingers into Polnareff's nose, but he doesn't know what to do from there. Making matters worse, Jotaro and the others show up in search of Polnareff, forcing Hol Horse into a tough spot.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Guardian of Hell, Pet Shop, Part 1
programmes.st: The Guardian of Hell, Pet Shop, Part 1
programmes.d: Jotaro and his friends continue to search for DIO's mansion in Cairo. Following Avdol's advice, they have a beggar look for the mansion and wait. Meanwhile, Iggy, wandering the city alone, is confronted by two large dogs.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Guardian of Hell, Pet Shop, Part 2
programmes.st: The Guardian of Hell, Pet Shop, Part 2
programmes.d: Iggy ends up in a battle to the death in the sewers against Pet Shop, the falcon that guards DIO's mansion. Despite being injured, Iggy runs to the river in an attempt to escape, but he may have underestimated Pet Shop's abilities.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: D'Arby the Player, Part 1
programmes.d: Though purchased dearly with Iggy's injury, Jotaro and his group finally have the location of DIO's palace. Waiting for them where they find the butler, Darby Younger, brother of the gambler they previously defeated.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: D'Arby the Player, Part 2
programmes.d: The battle for souls with D'Arby continues. Kakyoin challenges D'Arby to a racing game but ends up losing both the race and his soul. Before Joseph really has time to react, Jotaro picks the next game.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Miasma of the Void, Cool Ice, Part 1
programmes.st: The Miasma of the Void, Cool Ice, Part 1
programmes.d: The baseball game with D'Arby continues within DIO's mansion. For some reason, Jotaro starts telling D'Arby what pitches he'll be throwing. D'Arby finds Jotaro's actions strange, but still believes he has the upper hand because of his Stand's abilities.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Miasma of the Void, Cool Ice, Part 2
programmes.st: The Miasma of the Void, Cool Ice, Part 2
programmes.d: After a long, hard journey, the group is suddenly faced with saying goodbye to a friend. Polnareff can't control his emotions and starts brandishing his sword toward an unseen enemy with very little success.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Miasma of the Void, Cool Ice, Part 3
programmes.st: The Miasma of the Void, Cool Ice, Part 3
programmes.d: Polnareff is pushed to his limits by Cool Ice's merciless attacks. As he awaits death, the dying Iggy manages to save him at the last minute. Polnareff then stabs Cool Ice in the head. Despite showing resilience to the attacks so far.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: DIO's World, Part 1
programmes.d: Polnareff finally comes face-to-face with DIO. Despite Polnareff's hostility, DIO offers to forgive him and allow the Frenchman to join his side again. Polnareff refuses, but for some reason, he cannot get any closer to DIO.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: DIO's World, Part 2
programmes.d: As night falls, the battle expands to encompass the whole city of Cairo. Amidst the melee, Kakyoin says he has a way to figure out DIO's Stand ability.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: DIO's World, Part 3
programmes.d: Thanks to Kakyoin, Joseph is able to figure out that DIO's Stand, "The World," has the power to stop time, but is quickly defeated by DIO. Jotaro then attacks The World with Star Platinum but is no match for DIO's power.
As the battle with the Deep Sea King reaches its climax, more heroes fall to the aquatic despot's brutal attacks.
Saitama tags along to an emergency meeting of Class S heroes and discovers that a seer has foretold a serious danger threatening the Earth.
As a colossal spaceship floats in the skies above City A, a member of its monstrous crew battles on the ground against a group of S-Class heroes.
The inconceivably powerful Lord Boros has traveled untold distances in search of someone who can cure his boredom: Saitama!
Yuki has a lot on her mind after almost being kissed by Zero. She asserts that she will not speak to Kaname until he admits to Zero’s innocence.
The Night Class goes to the Aido family’s vacation home during the long break, but Hanabusa decides to stay at the academy because he suspects Kaname had something to do with Shizuka’s death.
Yuki, driven by her desire to stop hurting Zero, tries to regain her memory of the past and becomes haunted by even more powerful visions.
Yuki is continually haunted by visions of blood. Nevertheless, she is determined to find out about her past from Kaname, but he repeatedly evades her question.
Light, acting as L, reveals to Near that his sister Sayu has been kidnapped by someone wanting to trade her for the Death Note.
Light tries to discover where Mello and his Mafia associates are hiding and uses Misa's eyes to find the Death Note's current owner.
Mello busts into SPK headquarters to retrieve a photograph of himself to make sure he won't be killed by Kira.
Near contacts the Japanese task force and determines that Kira is among their members.
Star newscaster Kiyomi Takada becomes Kira's spokesperson to the world.
Light pretends to investigate Kiyomi.

programmes.t: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead (English Dubbed)
programmes.d: Akira's made his way to Shinjuku to see Kencho, the only friend he's still in touch with.

programmes.t: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead (English Dubbed)
programmes.d: Akira and Kencho take a trip to Ikebukuro to snag a big-screen TV.

programmes.t: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead (English Dubbed)
programmes.d: After remembering his childhood dream, Akira goes to the aquarium to grab an item he needs.

programmes.t: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead (English Dubbed)
programmes.d: Akira stops by a showroom in Saitama to get an RV. There he is reunited with Shizuka.

programmes.t: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead (English Dubbed)
programmes.d: With Kosugi in complete control of his mind, Akira makes an astonishing decision.

programmes.t: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead (English Dubbed)
programmes.st: Sushi & Hot Springs of the Dead
programmes.d: The gang runs into a German college student named Beatrix, who slices through a zombie!

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Natasha Raskin, Day 1
programmes.d: Natasha Raskin and Paul Laidlaw visit the West Coast of Scotland. Military buff Paul gets excited when he finds some desk ink stamps dating from the Cold War. Natasha ends up on ice as she gets to grips with an ancient sport in Ayrshire.

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Natasha Raskin, Day 2
programmes.d: Cumbria is the destination for Natasha Raskin and Paul Laidlaw and their classic Mercedes. Natasha visits a mint cake factory while Paul discovers an intriguing side to Cumbria's wartime past.

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Natasha Raskin, Day 3
programmes.d: Natasha Raskin and Paul Laidlaw are in historic York. Paul struggles to find anything he likes before plumping to buy a haul of agricultural salvage. And Natasha's eyes are turned by some spindles on a rocking chair.

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Natasha Raskin, Day 4
programmes.d: Natasha Raskin and Paul Laidlaw are taking their classic car around Norfolk and Suffolk. Paul finds himself as captain of a rare and valuable boat on the Norfolk Broads while Natasha ends up in Thetford woods looking for bunnies.

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Natasha Raskin, Day 5
programmes.d: Paul Laidlaw and Natasha Raskin are antiquing in Norfolk and there's one last auction in Diss. It's the final 'Round Britain Rummage' and they unearth a rarely seen art nouveau food warmer and a charming 19th-century table croquet set.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Raj Bisram, Day 1
programmes.d: The West Country beckons James Braxton and Raj Bisram. Kicking off in Bath, they motor through Bristol and Hungerford before boarding the Isle of Wight ferry. Both believe an island auction will attract bidders looking for nautical fare.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Raj Bisram, Day 2
programmes.d: Raj Bisram and James Braxton are on a buying spree on the Isle of Wight. James has a conversation with a man he believes is Elton John while Raj falls for a teddy and a ride on doggy. Only a few pounds separate the experts!

programmes.st: James Braxton and Raj Bisram, Day 3
programmes.d: It's a shopping spree through Somerset that ends at an auction in Woking. James thinks a pair of Staffordshire figures will attract big bids, despite some damage. Raj hopes the bidders will appreciate his experimental Moorcroft vase.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Raj Bisram, Day 4
programmes.d: James Braxton and Raj Bisram are in the beautiful New Forest. James dives into buying in the village of Brockenhurst, but all bets are off when Raj catches up with him in the market town of Ringwood.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Raj Bisram, Day 5
programmes.d: James Braxton and Raj Bisram set off in Cheshire. Raj hears why a group of daredevil playboys decided to drive their car in to the Savoy, and James learns why a pint in a pub played a vital role in verifying the quality of silver in 1773.

programmes.st: Raj Bisram and Irita Marriott, Day 1
programmes.d: Experts Raj Bisram and Irita Marriott hit the road again, this time in a Vanden Plas Princess. They are winding each other up, cracking bad jokes and looking for exquisite antiques in Wales. It's going to be a hair-raising adventure!

programmes.st: Raj Bisram and Irita Marriott, Day 2
programmes.d: Raj Bisram and Irita Marriott crisscross the Welsh border looking for antique goodies, but finding things that don't require two strong assistants to carry them is not easy.

programmes.st: Raj Bisram and Irita Marriott, Day 3
programmes.d: It's all gold and silver on Irita Marriott and Baj Bisram's third leg. But it's not all heavy metal - they find their groove in Birmingham's reggae heartland before a surprise auction result.

programmes.st: Raj Bisram and Irita Marriott, Day 4
programmes.d: Raj Bisram and Irita Marriott embark on a five-county tour of The Fens. On the way, they discover secret doors, prehistoric artifacts and time travel.

programmes.st: Raj Bisram and Irita Marriott, Day 5
programmes.d: Irita Marriott and Raj Bisram head to the seaside in Lincolnshire. It's the last chance to hit the shops before their final auction showdown.

programmes.st: Izzie Balmer and Mark Hill, Day 1
programmes.d: Jewelry expert Izzie Balmer and mid-century fan Mark Hill head to Wales in a 1987 Lotus Éclat to start off their new trip in Pembrokeshire. Magic tricks and a folding cake stand go to auction.

programmes.st: Izzie Balmer and Mark Hill, Day 2
programmes.d: New best friends Izzie Balmer and Mark Hill battle for bargain antiques in the towns and villages of Carmarthenshire, including special negligee jewelry, pitch pine furniture, a woven tapestry and glassware.

In 1908, Chief (Mario Van Peebles) returns from years of hiding to claim stolen gold. In his quest, he reunites an ensemble of familiar faces. Together, they fight off Angel, whose desire for the gold leaves a trail of dead bodies.
Who delivers ten times out of ten? Samuel L. Jackson is SHAFT, the man and the movie. John Singleton ("Boys 'n' the Hood") directs this gritty, action-packed thriller.

Director Antoine Fuqua brings his modern vision to the classic western, a story of seven outlaws who join together to save a town from an evil industrialist! Denzel Washington, Chris Pratt, Ethan Hawke and Vincent D'Onofrio and Peter Sarsgaard star!
If you thought it was just a trick of the mind, prepare yourself for the truth.
Miami cops Will Smith and Martin Lawrence are two loose cannons who tear up the Sunshine State in search of stolen drugs. Co-starring Tea Leoni. Explosive direction by Michael Bay (Armageddon).

The action and comedy never stop when Martin Lawrence and Will Smith reunite as out-of-control, trash-talking buddy cops. Bullets fly, cars crash, and laughs explode as they pursue a whacked-out drug lord from the streets of Miami to the barrios of Cuba.

Join EDDIE MURPHY on an unforgettable comic quest to the New World. As an African Prince, it's time for him to find a princess. The mission leads him and his most loyal friend (ARSENIO HALL) to New York. Watch Murphy and Hall in classic cameo roles!
As ‘The Chosen One’, Murphy’s on a madcap mission to save The Golden Child, a youth with mystical powers who’s been abducted by an evil cult.

An all jazz line-up on this edition of Soul! features pianist Horace Silver at the electric keyboard, Lee Morgan on trumpet and 22-year old Bobbi Humphrey playing the flute. They are joined by vocalists Andy and Salome Bey.
Katherine is very upset when she finds out that her mother has passed away.
Webster learns that you can be rich without having a lot of money after he gets struck with lottery fever.
When George is assigned to children's sports after a popular segment on Webster's hockey team, he worries his career will be damaged.
Rob's dad kidnaps him and Webster tries to rally up support to try and find him.
Jerry dresses up like a clown and takes Webster to the leukemia ward at the children's hospital, where he makes a new friend and realizes how lucky he is to be healthy.
The family flashes back to the Disco Decade when Ray and Lisa attend a 1970s theme party, while Tamera falls prey to a man who promises to launch her modeling career.
A high school nerd out to woo Tia turns to Tamera for help in updating his image, but when his makeover is complete, Tamera realizes she wants to keep him for herself!
When a girl from Tia's old neighborhood challenges her to a double Dutch jump rope contest, Tia becomes obsessed with winning.
Tia and Tamera wind up in student court, where the two boys who are supposedly defending them wind up dissing them instead.
Tia and Tamera audition for a game show, where their opponents are famous TV twins Mary-Kate and Ashley Olsen.
After spending the summer traveling with Q’s band, Moesha returns home sporting an engagement ring.
Someone places a hidden camera in Moesha and Niecy’s dorm room; Myles’ girlfriend tells him she’s pregnant—and he’s the father!
Moesha tries to straighten out her out-of-control roommates, but they’re more interested in chasing Boys II Men.

programmes.st: You Say He's Just A Friend
programmes.d: Moesha is tempted by her attraction to good-looking Jamal, while Dorian starts up his own hair solon.
While Frank and Dorian are on a road trip to Vegas, Myles falls hard for Moesha’s roommate, Alicia.
Anxious to become an adult, Brenda (Regina King) takes on part-time work, but soon discovers learning how to juggle all her responsibilities is a full-time job.

Brenda attempts to ensnare a boy's affection by inviting him to her Saturday night party, and following Sandra's sneaky suggestion, she tells him the party's on Friday night--but the scheme backfires when her parents go out for the evening.

Mary flies out to California to take a spin on the popular game show 'Wheel of Fortune,' but is shocked to discover a smug Sandra as her opponent--much to the dismay of hosts Pat Sajak and Vanna White.

Sandra's efforts to win the attention of a famous congressman (Robert Hooks) become muddled when Brenda's art teacher (Jayne Kennedy) catches his eye--yet in her pursuit she falls for another famous personality: Billy Dee Williams.
An aspiring radio sports announcer, Malcolm, and his talkative, would-be tow truck driver roommate, Eddie, attend a get-rich-quick seminar in hopes of winning a much-needed TV.
Eddie needs another job to get his prized tow truck repaired.
A chance to fill in on an all-night music show has Malcolm exhausted.
Malcolm and Eddie use their lottery winnings to buy their building from Kelly.
Eddie arranges for the Artist Formerly Known as Prince to appear at Kelly's re-opening party.

Faced with more bills than they can pay, Fred and Lamont decide to give a neighborhood party -- and charge admission. Everything goes well until two gangsters show up and make the Sanfords 'an offer they can't refuse.'

Fred thinks Lamont's fascinations with Africa are ludicrous, until he meets Olaiya, a Nigerian woman. Lamont adopts African dress and customs to impress Olaiya, but Lamont's lack of respect for his father interferes with his goal.
Fred is shocked when Lamont dates the sister of their Puerto Rican neighbor, Julio. The date becomes farcical when Fred's ploys to stop the date fail and he follows the couple -- in disguise.
Feeling jealous and neglected, Fred conjures up several ruses that will hopefully keep Lamont from spending so much time with Julio.

Lamont is upset when Fred announces that he plans to marry a young woman he has just met. When the young lady arrives at the house, Lamont is shocked to be face-to-face with one of his old girlfriends.

programmes.st: Home Sweet Home For The Aged
programmes.d: Fred is caught up in a series of frustrating situations when he becomes a resident of a senior citizens' home. Fred is put in the home by Lamont, who plans to work his way around the world on a tramp steamer and doesn't want to leave his father alone.
Allan Willis, the 'white sheep' of the racially-mixed Willis family, arrives in town after several years absence and finds things just as he left them -- hostile -- in the first of a two-part story.
Entrepreneur Christian Black pursues a young woman in a spoof of "Fifty Shades of Grey."
A pioneer of the culture joins forces with a few of rap music's elite performers to attempt to save hip hop.

Advertising executive Marcus Graham is a quintessential bachelor. Graham is never without a new lady on his arm. Enter Jacqueline, his new boss, and Marcus is on the receiving end of his own patented behavior for the first time!
Four friends conspire to turn the tables on their women when they discover the ladies have been using Steve Harvey's relationship advice against them.

All the couples are back for a wedding in Las Vegas, but plans for a romantic weekend go awry when their various misadventures get them into some compromising situations that threaten to derail the big event.

Advertising executive Marcus Graham is a quintessential bachelor. Graham is never without a new lady on his arm. Enter Jacqueline, his new boss, and Marcus is on the receiving end of his own patented behavior for the first time!
Upon learning of a terminal illness, a shy woman (Queen Latifah) decides to sell off all her possessions and live it up at a posh European hotel.

A successful sports agent (Taraji P. Henson) mysteriously gains the ability to hear men's thoughts. With this newfound power, she looks to outsmart her colleagues but the lengths she goes to put her relationships to the test in this hilarious comedy!
Weeks before Christmas, a struggling single mom battles addiction to reclaim her voice—and the love she lost.
After faking a terminal illness, a man's dysfunctional family shows up at his door for one last hurrah.
After her pact fails with her best friend, a woman looks to a sperm donor to have a baby before Christmas which also happens to be her 35th birthday.

Local realtor Nia helps an upscale developer find a property for a new resort. Sparks begin to fly between the two during the Christmas season until Nia realizes he has his eyes set on one property that's not for sale... her family's inn.
A prince from Europe comes to New York for a royal holiday dinner and falls in love with the chef that is planning the event.

Christmas is Heather's least favorite time of year. As the Manager of the upscale Shops at Town Center, she has to be the annual Christmas Grinch and cancel the leases of under-performing stores by the end of the year.
A woman strikes up a friendship with a homeless man and, through music, the two help each other reconcile with their families just in time for Christmas.
BET+ ORIGINAL. An expectant couple -- who are giving their relationship a second chance after being divorced -- host their family for Christmas despite a rapidly approaching due date.
Two corporate holiday party crashers find themselves in over their heads when they're invited into an influential family's home to plan their Christmas Eve bash.
Mark uses Vanessa's medical shoulder brace to get sympathy from a beautiful woman, but the charade gets out of control.
A trip to a nostalgic tree farm is ruined for Mark and his friends until they all learn the true meaning of Christmas.
Q comes home for Thanksgiving and asks Moesha for his ring back.
Moesha’s attempt to solve Niecy’s 'ain’t gotta man blues' backfires.
Moesha and Hakeem reminisce about their friendship and wonder if it could be developing into something more.
An ex-con is after Moesha, and Dorian decides to search for his birth mother.
Chris decides to take a stand against his mother, Rochelle and refuses to do his household chores, causing Rochelle to complain to Julius that her son is disrespecting her.

Chris works up the courage to ask Tasha to be his girlfriend and is surprised when she accepts. Unfortunately, Chris had no clue that being a boyfriend entailed giving up all his free time and only doing things that Tasha wants to do.

Chris accidentally hits Greg while test driving the janitor's car, landing Greg in the hospital with a broken leg. Meanwhile, with both of Greg's parents out of town, Rochelle decides to skip the family vacation so she can take care of Greg.
During the last week of school, Chris is informed that if he gets one more tardy he will have to repeat the 10th grade.

programmes.st: The Big Doormat No More Episode
programmes.d: After telling Mona not to let people take advantage of her, Dee Dee later regrets giving her that advice when she asks Mona a favor and is turned down.

programmes.st: The Big Who's Wooing Who? Episode
programmes.d: When Mona is courted and gets a job offer from another record label, she has to make a choice between staying at Delicious Records or moving on. Meanwhile, in order to keep up with the Jones’, Big Dee Dee plans an extravagant birthday party for Drew.

programmes.st: The Big Mother For Others Episode
programmes.d: When Big Dee Dee crashes in on Phyllis’ Charity telethon meeting, Phyllis loses it and reveals to everyone that Big Dee Dee was pregnant before she married Charles. Meanwhile, Mona confronts Phyllis about her annoying habit of making blunt comments.

programmes.st: The Big Thorne In My Side Episode
programmes.d: When Phyllis gets into trouble with her Homeowner's Association, Dee Dee comes to her defense, but ends up causing more harm than good.
Mark is hired as a substitute teacher, but his roommate Robin must teach him how to control his students. Alan Thicke guest stars.

Mark injures himself while performing a story for his substitute first-grade class, including Michelle Tanner (MARY KATE/ASHLEY OLSEN). Afterward, Mark is too embarrassed to keep his date with a beautiful woman (GALYN GORG).
Mark's ex-girlfriend, Paula (LELA ROCHON), moves back into town and revives their passionate romance.
Mark helps a student basketball player (CHRISTOPHER CARTER) pass an important algebra test. Chris Tucker guest stars.
When Mark coaches a girls' cheerleading team, he desperately asks Vanessa to help him train the untalented cheerleaders.
After Mark finally gets a permanent teaching job as a basketball coach, he's offered a contract to play for the Warriors, a professional basketball team. First of a two-part episode.

Mark is given a temporary contract to play professional basketball with his favorite team, the Warriors. Unfortunately, Mark must play guard against basketball star Charles Barkley (HIMSELF). Second of a two-part episode.
Mark and Robin try to make Andre choose between his interests in basketball and music.
Nikki gets a taste of her own medicine after Professor Oglevee’s young nephew becomes obsessed with her.
While Kim and Stevie try speed-dating, Professor Oglevee worries that he’s becoming a boy toy.
Stevie and her mother move in with Nikki and Kim.
Earvin ‘Magic’ Johnson hires Nikki to manage his movie theater.
When Professor Oglevee loses his job, he turns to Nikki for more than just moral support.
The Professor has a one-night stand with Nikki.
Eddie fears a family curse will make him a werewolf on Halloween.
After faking an injury in order to sue Malcolm and Eddie, an unruly customer suddenly dies in the kitchen.
An old college rival shows up at the bar looking to avenge a game of pool he lost to Malcolm.
Acting on a rumor that the local football team is moving, a crazed fan takes the bar hostage.
After an argument with his wife of 49 years, Malcolm's grandfather arrives to stay with him and Eddie.

Sisters Olanna and Kainene return home to 1960s Nigeria, where they soon diverge on different paths. As civil war breaks out, political events loom larger than their differences as they join the fight to establish an independent republic.
An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

A look at three defining chapters in the life of Chiron, a young Black man growing up in Miami. His epic journey to manhood is guided by the kindness, support, and love of the community that helps raise him.
The true, inspiring story of Jim Ellis, a charismatic school teacher who changed lives forever when he founded an African-American swim team in one of Philadelphia's roughest neighborhoods.
An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

A look at three defining chapters in the life of Chiron, a young Black man growing up in Miami. His epic journey to manhood is guided by the kindness, support, and love of the community that helps raise him.

Calvin, who inherited a struggling barbershop, views the shop as nothing but a burden and waste of his time. After selling the shop to a local loan shark, Calvin slowly begins to see his father's vision and legacy .
The Barbershop is threatened by the arrival of a hip, well-financed chain barbershop that's about to open next door.

programmes.st: A Silver Dollar Saved, Is A Silver Dollar Earned
programmes.d: Jon heads to the Silver Dollar in Chula Vista, California, where the unresolved tensions between the father and son owners have led to operational issues and neglect.
A military hero about to be redeployed needs more than his bar rescued, as his problematic drinking threatens to cost him his livelihood and relationship.

programmes.st: Anything You Can Yell, I Can Yell Louder
programmes.d: In order to save a failing Queens dive, Jon has to quell the raging tempers of three loudmouthed, firefighting brothers.
Jon must go to war with the rowdy regulars of a Southern California dive bar once a popular haven for smokers until forced to comply with the law.
The customers call the shots at a rowdy Staten Island bar where they pour their own drinks and cook their own food, so Jon tries to help the owners retake control.
Jon travels to Oakland, California, to help Marshawn Lynch turn around his bar, Rob Ben's, by teaching the NFL star to treat his staff less like family and more like a team.
He's no stranger to unkempt bars, but Jon is absolutely disgusted by the rat, roach, and raccoon problem inside Freaki Tiki.

Nick tries to become a more effective parent, so he pushes Kevin and Lindsey to become better people.

Suzanne becomes the subject to Nick's joke-off, and Suzanne retaliates against him.

Nick, Suzanne, and Kevin pull pranks on each other, but their addiction leads to a near-death experience.

A newly hired, attractive woman threatens Nick's job at the station.

Linda is shocked to discover that her old flame from high school, Carl is now very rich.
Danny bets Sam that he can't endure staying in the apartment for a full weekend.
After attending a funeral, Sam finally decides to make a change in his life.
Drew tries to keep her date away from Marianna, believing she might steal him from her.

programmes.st: The Good Cop, Bad Cop Episode
programmes.d: When Suzanne gets tired of playing the role of bad cop to Nick's good cop, she makes it Nick's job to say \\"No\\" to the kids for an entire week.
Nick runs into an old college friend, who convinces him to bring Deion Sanders aboard his energy drink business – with humiliating consequences.
Suzanne and Nick go out with another couple, but the double date soon fizzles when an accusation flies.

Tensions reach new levels between Phor and Nina in the aftermath of the lingerie party. Draya takes a DNA test to see just how big her family really is. With Don's daughter and her mother living in a different state, Don struggles to reach them.

While 9MAG wraps up construction and celebrates the reopening of the shop, Don struggles with being a long-distance dad. A prank war between Prince and B-Slam takes Prince's tattoo experience into a different world.

9MAG hires a familiar face to work at the shop. With his dad's health deteriorating, Prince is forced to make changes for his future. Guys' night out takes a left turn when a surprise visit disrupts the party.

Ceaser has a new opportunity to expand Black Ink but not everyone is happy with the deal, leaving him to question where loyalties lie. Donna plans a girls' night that's full of rowdy surprises. Walt and Jess can't see eye to eye.

An unexpected drug test has Tati freaking out. Sky announces a huge surprise. Quani makes a decision that shocks Puma. Rok airs out his dirty laundry - literally. And problems with the Brooklyn shop puts Ceaser on a collision course with the police.

Ceaser deals with the fallout of his arrest, and what it means for the Brooklyn shop. Alex and Donna try to get their mojo back in the bedroom. Bae confronts a shocking diagnosis. And Sky embarks on a new venture.

programmes.st: Nice Day For A Shotgun Wedding
programmes.d: Donna brings up people in Brooklyn talking trash about the upcoming Black Ink, which sets Ceaser off on a spiral through the past. Walt tries to make amends with Jessica. Sky embarks on a new business adventure. And Bae receives a welcome surprise.

After missing for a couple of weeks, Ted comes clean to Ceaser and Puma about why he's been so absent. Mike finally receives his long-awaited paternity test results. Jessica brings her son Xavier to meet Walt. Mike has a medical emergency.

The Brooklyn shop is finally open and Ceaser throws a block party to celebrate the grand opening. After Donna gives Alex an ultimatum, things don't go as expected. Crystal has a new jaw and a new attitude. Bae finds out Tati is hiding a big secret.

After opening the Brooklyn shop, rumors swirl about the altercation between Crystal and Miss Kitty. Sky struggles with the future of her Miami shop. News that Tati is dating a new man causes issues for Ted. Puma courts Rich for a return to the shop.

The crew heads to Cleveland for the first stop on Walt's comedy tour and to see Donna's hometown, but there are fireworks right off the bat. Alex finally meets Donna's dad and things don't go as planned.
Walt headlines his first comedy show tour in Cleveland. Kitty threatens to sue Ceaser while Alex tries to win Donna's dad over.

When Sky announces a Black Ink Prom, the competition for who will be King and Queen gets fierce. Q works with Crystal to get Ceaser back. One of Donna's tattoo clients sends a threatening letter to the shop.

programmes.st: The Problem With Torture Is Everybody Confesses
programmes.d: The crew is still reeling from the disastrous prom when Ceaser's most prized possession turns up missing. He launches an investigation into the potential thief which leads to some surprising decisions. Sky's son Des tries to track down his mom.

The news of Sky's suspension rocks the crew while Donna can't accept her apprentice demotion. Ceaser gets political and organizes a voter drive while Q faces a reckoning when his mom visits. Ceaser declares war on Ryan from 9MAG.

programmes.st: Dogs are More Loyal than Kits
programmes.d: Ceaser fumes over the video with Ryan and Kitty and plots revenge. Donna attempts to get her job back. Bae gets set up by a matchmaker and finds an unlikely bond with Rok. Walt and Jess' engagement party goes wheels off.
After a disastrous engagement party, Walt and Jess attend premarital counseling while the rest of the crew encourage Bae to face her biggest fear - confronting her abusive father.

Erin faces off in court against her ex-husband, Jack (Peter Hermann), who is representing the person she is attempting to convict of murder. Also, Danny and Baez investigate to see if the husband is behind the murder of his wife.

After Reggie Wilson (Cyrus Farmer), a witness in a former case of Erin's, asks her for help shutting down a drug operation in his apartment building, she makes it her mission to make the building safe for his family.
Danny and Baez team up with two Russian operatives to search for a dangerous Russian man who entered the U.S. on a diplomatic visa.
When Danny intercepts a shipment of several million dollars that was heading to a drug cartel in Mexico, he becomes a target when they come back for revenge.

After a young girl goes missing, the family argues whether Danny used questionable methods in order to bring her home safely. Meanwhile, Jamie graduates from the police academy and begins his new life as a cop, on the series premiere.
A good Samaritan who takes action against a criminal terrorizing the subway has the Reagans pondering the rights and wrongs of vigilantism.
With a bomb set to detonate in Manhattan, Frank, Danny, and the rest of the NYPD search for its whereabouts. In the midst of the search, the Reagans argue the merits and downfalls of profiling.
Erin's family debates her methods when she uses a law-abiding citizen as bait to take down his gang leader brother.
Erin, Frank, and Danny work together within the system to find justice when a rape case's primary suspect is protected by diplomatic immunity.
Frank mobilizes the entire NYPD to find the killer of an off-duty police officer who was murdered during a diamond heist.
Danny works to discover the source of a deadly narcotic after three teenagers die from a drug overdose.
After witnessing a crime in progress, Jamie's suspect is killed in the pursuit. Danny must solve the case to clear Jamie's name and keep IA from a full-blown investigation.
Three released prison inmates place the Reagan family in danger.
While Danny investigates the murder of a popular nightclub's doorman, Frank gets information that his ex-partner is covering up crimes.
A 25-year-old cold case of Frank's is brought to the forefront when the missing boy's remains are found. Danny and Jackie look into the death of a high-end escort.
Because it involves classified information and a sleeper cell, Frank assigns Danny to cover the shooting of an undercover counter-terrorism agent.
When the son of a Russian gangster is killed at his own engagement party, Danny delves into the world of the Russian mob. Meanwhile, Erin is thrown into a high-profile corruption case.
When the woman he was planning to marry is strangled, Joe forces the only suspect to come forward.
Professor Klump and Amanda pull Hoss into their flying machine scheme. The ""Hoss-mobile""doesn't seem to be destined for a great take-off.
While out hunting for a mountain lion, Joe accidentally shots Tessa Caldwell causing her to go blind.  As a result of his guilt, Joe ends up proposing to the girl.
Ben and Claire Armory fall in love, but their future is jeopardized by her disabled brother.
Two Virginia City old-timers fool Hoss and Joe into raising rabbits, and the Ponderosa is overrun with paws and whiskers.

In this sequel to "The Waiting Game", Laura resents Adam's advice on how she ought to be running her ranch.  A newcomer, Ward Bannister, comes to her aid, but is actually part of a scheme to steal her ranch.
Adam tries to find the good in Howard Mead, a talented troubadour who refuses to stay on the right side of the law.
As payment for a performance in a circus, Joe and Hoss are given an elephant.  They want to keep it but encounter opposition from Adam and Ben.
After their stagecoach crashes, a group of rag-tag passengers and Joe must get out of the desert alive.  One of the passengers may or may not be a murderer and Joe is accused.
Joshua Norton, an eccentric and formerly wealthy San Francisco merchant who considers himself Emperor of the United States and Protector of Mexico, comes to the Ponderosa.
The Cartwrights protect a woman and her deaf-mute little son from the boy's outlaw stepfather.
Ben finds an old journal that he kept while in a wagon train travelling from St. Joseph, Missouri to Ash Hollow.
Cousin Muley Jones returns to the Ponderosa, along with a pack of noisy hound dogs, in this funny sequel to "The Saga Of Muley Jones".
Ben invites opera singer Angela Bergstrom to perform at Virginia City's anniversary celebration.  She accepts, but does not tell him that her famous singing voice is long gone
The peaceful world of a Ponderosa hand is disturbed by the arrival of his no-good father and twin brother, who is a wanted man.
One of Joe's old girlfriends thinks he killed her husband so they could come together.  Unfortunately, that is what her husband's twin brother also believes.
Hoss befriends a self-demeaning recluse named Patch, who makes the best apple pie Hoss has ever tasted.
The Five Kage agree to place Kawaki under Naruto’s custody. Naruto takes Kawaki home, but the atmosphere between Boruto and Kawaki turns threatening.
Boruto is furious that Kawaki has broken a vase that his little sister had made for their mother, fanning the flames between them. As a fellow wielder of the Karma, Kawaki makes a proposal.
Kawaki goes into town with Naruto to get a new vase to replace the one that he broke. On the way to the Yamanaka Flower Shop, they are joined by Sarada.
Kawaki watches a Shinobi Hand-to-Hand Combat match between Naruto and Boruto. Boruto uses his specialty, the Shadow Clone Jutsu, to take on his father, but he struggles.
In order to get a better handle on their Karmas, Boruto and Kawaki decide to train under more realistic conditions.
Delta forces her way into the Leaf Village to take Kawaki back and appears before Boruto and the others. In response, Naruto unleashes the power of the Nine Tails, and a fierce clash ensues!
Delta uses her destructive beam that can neutralize any regenerative power. Undaunted, Naruto forcefully suppresses it with a Giant Rasengan.
Delta informs Jigen that Boruto also has a Karma on his palm. Upon hearing this, Jigen smiles…
As Naruto sleeps, Kawaki repairs the vase he broke. Suddenly, Kurama, the Nine-Tailed Beast, appears before him.
Using the Transportation Technique, Sasuke arrives at a strange location that is covered with mysterious inscriptions. There he finds many surprising things about the Otsutsuki Clan.
A direct confrontation between Naruto, the Seventh Hokage, and Jigen, the leader of the Kara, finally begins!
Naruto and Sasuke work together to defeat Jigen in a fierce battle, but they struggle against Jigen's advanced fighting abilities and mysterious jutsu.
With the enemy's sudden appearance, Naruto, the Seventh Hokage and leader of the village, has vanished.
Boruto and the others attack Boro to save Naruto, but Boro drives them back by releasing a mysterious dark mist that paralyses his opponents.
The newly formed Team 7's all-out attack damages Boro, and their efforts seem to be successful. However, Boro uses his regenerative powers to revive himself.
Despite sustaining serious damage from the new Team 7, Boro goes on a mad rampage, threatening Boruto and the others with total annihilation.
Kawaki begins to worry that his presence puts Hidden Leaf Village at risk, especially since Kara is after him.
In order to learn more about Boro’s connection to Kara, Konohamaru and Sai are tasked with a mission to infiltrate Boro's cult.
Someone has stolen data about the Leaf Ninja, and it’s suspected a spy may have been planted inside the village.
Amado, a principal member of Kara who oversaw their research and development, kidnaps Shikadai and seeks asylum in the Leaf Village.
In exchange for being granted asylum in the Village Hidden in the Leaves, Amado reveals everything he knows.
The battle between Koji Kashin and Jigen begins at Kara’s hideout.
Isshiki finally appears in his true form and goes to attack the Hidden Leaf Village to capture Kawaki.
Boruto pulls Isshiki into another dimension for a final showdown.
Naruto and Sasuke fight fiercely, but their efforts are in vain as Isshiki drives them into a corner.
Momoshiki has taken control of Boruto’s consciousness and stands before them as an enemy.
Amado provides some new information concerning Code, whose powers surpass Jigen.
Naruto convenes a Five Kage Summit to discuss what they should do about Boruto’s condition, as well as Cord, one of the leaders of Kara.
Naruto, proposes that the Chunin Exam be held to raise morale after Isshiki’s attack.

Uncle Joe decides to bankrupt the Hooterville Cannonball by starting his own railroad, powered by Orville Miggs' flivver.
Homer Bedloe becomes superintendent of the Hooterville Cannonball. He forces Charley & Floyd to keep to a strict schedule, all in his latest attempt to shut the train line down.
Socialite Clara Watkins is an important guest at Shady Rest. Unless she recommends the place to her friends, the bank won't lend Kate any more money.
Everyone seems too busy to spend any time with Charley, so he decides to quit his job as engineer of the Hooterville Cannonball.
Rob recalls the time he defended his title as middleweight champion of the Army camp.

programmes.st: See Rob Write, Write Rob Write
programmes.d: Rob and Laura clash over which of them is the better writer of a children's story.
After getting into a fight with Laura, Rob heads to the bar but winds up getting questioned by police.
Rob recalls the time he was out of work with a new home, no furniture and a pregnant wife.
Gomer's conned into signing a contract for dancing lessons.

programmes.st: Sergeant Carter Gets a 'Dear John' Letter
programmes.d: Carter asks Gomer to take his place on a date.
Carter's adopted Korean daughter arrives, but she's not the little girl he remembers.
Carter tries for the Officer Candidate School.
Gomer tries to collect money for Carter's birthday.
Carter may have to use Gomer as an honor guard since he owns a blue dress uniform.
Corporal LeBeau pretends to be a visiting French scientist while Hogan smuggles out the real one.
Hogan sneaks out of camp to a local German Hofbrau House to get the details of a nearby German army unit.

programmes.st: Oil For The Lamps Of Hogan
programmes.d: The Germans want to safely build a synthetic fuel plant in Stalag 13, but Hogan convinces them that there is oil beneath the camp.
During an operation to send out twenty Allied soldiers, two of them attempt an early escape and are nearly captured.
Hogan talks Klink into building an officers' club, whereby a boat can be built to sail away with an escaped British POW and the German gunsight he snagged while escaping.
Hogan and his men must destroy a German anti-aircraft artillery unit so that the Allies can send in a bombing raid on Hitler's birthday.

Whatever you do, don't say her name and especially while playing checkers down at Drucker's! An old hag named Molly Turgiss (Renie Riano), who died twenty years before the Douglases (Eddie Albert, Eva Gabor) came to town, might be haunting them.

programmes.st: Never Look A Gift Tractor In The Mouth
programmes.d: It's a few days before Oliver (Eddie Albert)'s birthday, and Lisa (Eva Gabor) doesn't know quite what to get him…until the old Hoyt Clagwell goes kerflooey! So, she goes out and buys the biggest and fanciest tractor she can find.
Stone and Keller suspect that an artist's fatal fall from his studio window was not an accident.
Joe Mannix receives an urgent letter from a woman named Lynn Sargent asking him to fly to Arizona. She meets him at the airport and hands him a check for $1,000 and a small sealed package.
Peggy calls Mannix when her young black male friend and his wounded partner show up, as innocent bystanders from a deadly liquor store robbery.
A shady lawyer suspected of throwing Joe's friend from a high-rise, hires him to look for a woman he claims he nearly ran over during the time of the crime.

Jean McBride, an old flame of Joe Mannix' who still lives in his hometown of Summer Grove, appears in his office one evening. Jean is married to Troy McBride, who once quarterbacked the Summer Grove football team on which Mannix also played.
Young Shelley Barrett tries to get to Barnaby, whom she believes is her father. She gets arrested on the way. Barnaby has to clear her, help her mother,and prove he is not the father.

J.R. investigates the disappearance of a real estate agent at a resort lodge run by two sisters and their aunt.. The murders pile up as he begins to realize that he's in the midst of a nest of scorpions with these women.
Barnaby and J.R. get involved in a kidnapping for ransom that goes bad and a former associate gets killed during the drop off -or so it appears.
Jedediah is set up on a phony rape charge and sets out to clear his name and find those responsible.

Tennis star defects to US during a Hawaiian tourney. In love with American Brent Saunders, she's taken from her Communist team. Plans upset when team member Peter Valchek murders coach, putting Steve McGarrett in dangerous international situation.

The murder of a U.S. Navy submarine officer on a Hawaiian beach at about the same time that a nearby mystery submarine is detected, causes McGarrett to suspect that he may be investigating more than just a run-of-the-mill killing.
Brilliant Uni students dupe entire Honolulu with false tidal wave alert, stealing millions in jewelry. Even McGarrett is fooled in Five-O.
Dr. Sandanarik, exiled from tyranny, dies in watery tragedy. Widows claims murder, McGarrett investigates. Key to puzzle may be missing student Kati Parisa, a potential witness.

McGarrett becomes the unofficial watchdog of a love triangle consisting of 18-year-old David Kaluna, David's sweetheart 16-year-old Debbie Cameron, and George Cameron, Debbie's wealthy and influential father who detests David for his lowborn origin.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Old family conflicts resurface when Officer Luann Corbin's brother Tyler is released from prison and moves back home, driving a wedge between Luann, who thinks it’s a bad idea and that Tyler will never change, and her mother, who welcomes him.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Obsessed with his ex-girlfriend, a disturbed teenager kills her new boyfriend and pins the murder on her stepfather. Althea sees the teen’s hostility at school and realizes how dangerous he is. Can he be stopped from making one more fatal mistake?

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Althea Tibbs struggles with depression after witnessing the shocking suicide of a student, and the dead teen’s ex-girlfriend starts dating a guy with a criminal record, who she’s desperate to flee Sparta with to escape from her abusive stepfather.

programmes.st: Hunter: S5 E1 - Heir Of Neglect
programmes.d: Hunter investigates the case of a teenage boy who mistakenly shot his parents during what he claimed was a home invasion.
A film school buddy of Alex's is at Community General Hospital making a documentary about the legend of a ghost in the basement.
When a hit-and-run patient mysteriously dies in the hospital, Dr. Sloan and his interns, Jack and Amanda, put their amateur crime solving abilities to the test.
A mobster's gun moll fakes her way past hospital security guards, and Dr. Sloan almost becomes her next victim! Attractive and smart, no one suspected Amy Westin's true identity.
Walker is taking some kids on a tour of the Texas Ranger Hall of Fame. When one of them asks him to tell them about a Ranger, Walker chooses to talk about Hayes Cooper.

Walker continues to tell the story of Hayes Cooper. And he continues when Cooper upon seeing the family he befriended killed, he sets out to go after the ones he believes responsible for their deaths.

A boy with telepathic powers escapes the laboratory where he was living since his mother supposedly died. He learns his mother is alive so he contacts Walker to ask for assistance. The doctors try to destroy evidence and kill witnesses.
Feeling that merely locking up criminals is not making a dent in the crime rate, Walker makes a proposal for new kind reformatory, before Senator Kay Hutchinson.
Richard Kimble becomes chauffeur in the strange household of a teenage violin virtuoso.
Richard Kimble stumbles into the intrigues of a politically ambitious man when he rescues a leading citizen and his woman companion from a plane crash.
Neuropsychiatrist Mark Ryder employs a computer and Lt. Gerard's help to plan Richard Kimble's capture.
MacGyver is forced to settle a dispute between the Amish and some land developers after an accident threatens the lives of two children.

programmes.st: On A Wing And A Prayer
programmes.d: MacGyver and Jack Dalton, posing as arms dealers, infiltrate a Latin American rebel camp where a wounded Pete Thornton is being held hostage.
MacGyver finds himself behind the wheel of an experimental race car after his buddy is injured In a mysterious crash during the qualifying heats.

Tonight, of all nights, Murphy's Law is definitely operating at its worst! After finally finagling all the details to put together a money-raising telethon for the hospital, Dr. Sloan loses his cool when the host of the show is murdered - on the air!
A late night call for help sends Dr. Sloan racing to the rescue! Ninety-two-year-old millionaire Jonathan Nash fears for his life.
A supposed 'ticket to heaven' leads to a trail of greedy scam artists and gamblers! Dying of a gunshot wounds, a man gives Dr. Sloan a winning lottery ticket.
Dennis eludes his babysitter to go to the movie that his parents are seeing.
Dennis and Tommy replace a fallen street signpost but fail to notice they’ve put it up with the street names facing in the wrong direction.
Henry and George try to go fishing without Dennis.
Dennis tries to fix up his Grandpa Perkins with Miss Cathcart.
