programmes.d: Betty falls in love with a cowboy on a dude ranch.  Neither her experience nor the love lasts

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Betty Goes To College
programmes.d: Margaret and Jim are excited about Betty starting college.  Sadly, in their excitement, they overlook what their daughter actually wants to do.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Man About Town
programmes.d: Bud tries to date an older woman named Marisa by lying about his age.  However, things get sticky when Marissa wants to go to an exclusive restaurant.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: The Homing Pigeon
programmes.d: Bud's homing pigeon and Betty scare the family by not returning home immediately.
The owner of a Middle East Delicacies store, upon learning Mr. French is unmarried and knowing he is wealthy, introduces him to his cousin, Nural Shpeni, who he and her brothers want Nural to marry.

The vice principal and a child psychologist are concerned that Buffy and Jody only spend time with each other instead of playing with the other children, and state that it would be better for them to spend less time together.

Cissy thinks Bill is planning to get married to an old friend, but when her new friend tells her how her stepmothers sent her away, Cissy then suspects that the woman will send her and Buffy and Jody away.

Restless, Bill takes a job in the Yucatan, but then starts to miss the family. It gets worse when he is led to believe, through miscommunication by phone, that Mr. French has the flu and Buffy and Jody are left to take care of him.

programmes.st: A Club House Is Not A Home
programmes.d: The boys refuse to share their clubhouse with the girls.
The Bradys fear they will have to give away Tiger due to Jan’s allergies.
Cindy’s lead role in a school play causes a family crisis.
Alice doesn't think the boys need her as much anymore now that Carol is in the house--so she announces that she is leaving.
Marcia nominates Mike for a Father of the Year award.
The Brady kids fight over what to buy with their trading stamps.

It's Edith and Archie Bunker's 22nd wedding anniversary and their daughter Gloria and her husband Mike are planning a surprise Sunday brunch. Edith is pleasantly surprised, however, Archie's 'no big deal' attitude leads to a huge argument.

Mike writes a letter to President Nixon protesting everything that's wrong with America, including the state of the environment and the nation's involvement in Vietnam. Archie finds out, and he decides he also will write a letter to Tricky Dick.
While moonlighting, driving a taxi for Bert Munson, Archie is in a minor fender bender with a Jewish woman.

Roger, a friend of Mike and Gloria's, stops by. Archie takes one look and labels him as gay even though Mike insists that he isn't. Mike makes a realization that one of Archie's drinking buddies, Steve is a well-adjusted, straight-acting, gay man.
Mike is set to go down to the blood bank to donate some blood and asks Archie if he would like to donate.

Gloria comes home from the doctor with some news: she's pregnant. This leads to a big argument between Archie and Mike so Mike decides to quit school and move out. Archie doesn't believe him until Mike gets a job in Detroit and plans on moving there.

programmes.st: Mike's Hippie Friends Come To Visit
programmes.d: Just before leaving on a flight to Europe, Mike's hippie friends need a place to stay for the night. Mike invites them to stay in the Bunker's living room, however, Archie objects citing that no unmarried couple will spend the night under his roof.

Archie discovers that a new family is moving to the neighborhood. He goes over to investigate, only to discover that the new family is black. Archie quickly hopes to round the neighborhood up and try to force the family out of the area.

Naomi gets an obscene phone call and doesn't tell the family until the guy calls again. The family unsuccessfully tries to figure out why this guy is after Naomi, blaming her in the process. The family later apologizes.
Ellen has met an attractive, younger man named Glen, but doesn't want Mama to meet him because of the age difference. After the family learns Glen is Ellen's new boyfriend, Mama freaks out.

When the nursing home decides to throw a surprise party for Mama's Aunt Gert, Mama fears that she will end up bored in a nursing home like her. Mama and Aunt Gert ultimately liven up the boring event and everyone has fun.
When a talent contest is announced at the Bigger Jigger, Vint is a big hit and ends up winning, but this starts going to his head.

programmes.st: The Mama Who Came to Dinner
programmes.d: Fran comes up with a way Vint and Naomi can have a dinner party. Mama is against it until Naomi says anything they could have at Mama's would be second-rate.

Mama desperately wants to go to the mall and pick up a hat she really wants, but no one can drive her. The family attempts to teach Mama to drive which is unsuccessful until Mama realizes she may lose out on her hat.

Naomi returns from her self-defense class and shows the family what she learned. Fran and Sonja are impressed with what Naomi does and says and decide to join. After Mama is mugged, she decides to join as well.

The loving aunt of a close-knit family is stabbed to death in her home. It takes two decades for detectives to discover that a key witness was an imposter--and caused the case to go cold.

A family is torn apart by their grandparents' murders. Two decades later, a cold case detective takes on the case that has haunted him since he was a child--racing to solve it before the family takes matters into their own hands.

After 46 years, LA homicide detectives take a Lover's Lane bandit who also gunned down two police officers into custody. Then, DNA testing helps lead police in Florida to a suspected killer, however, the killer has an identical twin.

The brutal stabbing murder of a Florida woman is solved when police find crucial DNA evidence in spit left on the pavement. And a man is put away for rape and murder when his footprint matches the footprint he left at the crime scene 18 years before.

A killer helps convict himself when he boasts about his crime to prison cellmates; and New Hampshire investigators probing the murder of a pregnant woman found raped, strangled, and dumped into her bathtub, get a new lead.

When 31-year-old real estate appraiser Mike Williams mysteriously vanishes while duck hunting in the Florida swamps in December of 2000, authorities suspect he accidentally drowned. For sixteen years his disappearance remains a mystery.

A North Carolina man looking to clear his conscience gives police the information they need to solve a murder. And Indiana police are baffled by the murder of an 86-year-old woman, found dead in her bedroom.

programmes.st: Bump In The Night/Hitchhike To Murder
programmes.d: A woman who takes down the license plate number of a car that had been following her helps police solve the murder of another young woman.

A detective keeps a murder investigation going for 16 years and finally proves a woman killed her husband in a satanic rite; THE BURNING SECRET: and a rape victim fails to get a conviction on her attacker.

Klan leader Sam Bowers goes on trial for ordering the murder of an African-American storeowner 32 years prior, and investigators reopen the unsolved case of an African-American truck driver who was forced to leap to his death from a bridge by Klan member

In the 1980s, a serial killer prowled the posh streets of Orange County. Police were unaware of the serial attacks until 1996, when DNA revealed the killer's secret and they linked four murders to a single DNA profile.

Detectives are baffled when two young girls are raped, murdered, and dumped in an abandoned house in Akron, Ohio. And a 26-year-old mother of three disappears on Christmas Eve in 1995, but the missing person case goes cold when police can find few clues

A forensic scientist's painstaking examination of a rape kit helps solve the 15-year-old murder of a teenage girl. And when California investigators probe the murder of a 71-year-old man, they get help from the top suspect's former therapist.

Fire investigator Jack Malooly helps crack the case of an arsonist and killer who set fires to collect insurance money, and a prison inmate tells a detective that he can't help him with his current investigation, but knows about a 15-year-old murder.

programmes.st: Left for Dead / On the Case (#126)
programmes.d: A detective in California tracks down a prostitute's killer with the help of a key piece of evidence. And two persistent cold case detectives use DNA to investigate the 1990 murder of a woman and the death of a man killed in a car crash in 1988.

Near what's known as the hanging tree, the mutilated body of Timothy Coggins is found in late 1983. The investigation is thwarted and the case freezes for over 30 years, until a newly elected sheriff vows to bring the killers to justice.

programmes.st: Green River Killer/Missing And The Dead
programmes.d: In 1982 and '83, Seattle's Green River Killer stalked prostitutes like game. With 49 victims, he could be the deadliest serial killer in U.S. history. Then, a passing motorist spots a fire along a road in South Carolina and calls it in.

Abbi, Ilana, Jaime and Lincoln house-sit for the Strands. Ilana and Lincoln define their relationship, and Abbi has a Bumble date with a man from her past.
Sarah gets picked up on a DUI, and Brian insists that he's a bisexual.
To cure herself of the blahs, Sarah gets an AIDS test; Jay has a birthday party for the first time.
When Alice makes the office sell a terrible product that her dad invented, the guys discover they can use it as a cover to deal weed over the phone.
The guys throw their own version of Coachella to impress some girls.
The office holds a remote-controlled car race, and Blake adopts a mouse.
The guys watch an old episode of the TV dating show Termidate to remember what happens when they compete for a woman's affections.
The guys try to get rid of a motivational speaker when she begins interfering with a beloved office awards show.
The guys become party gods after an energy drink company starts paying them to throw ragers.
Luther informs Mitt Romney who won the election, and a non-stop party refuses to stop.
Two gang rivals get inside each other's heads, and a police officer hones his act.
A tough guy cries in front of his crew, and substitute teacher Mr. Nostrand does not play.
One man's bikini-clad woman is another man's mystery, and two friends step up their hat game.

Nathan comes up with a way to sell alcohol to minors, helps an exterminator land a hotel contract and uses birds to draw customers to a car wash.
After being dumped by a client, Sam and Tim court a competitor in a bid for revenge.
When Lea demands that the guys pay for her health insurance, they go on a journey around town to scrape together money from outstanding debts.
The deputies raise money selling delicious Coconut Nut Clusters door-to-door.
Dangle reconnects with his family after his estranged father passes away.
The department's new bulletproof vests for women have an unexpected side effect: super knockers.
Rick the Burger Cousin manager is a cruel taskmaster when deputies go undercover flipping burgers.
Mr. Mackey, the school counselor, is fired and turns to drugs and alcohol. Meanwhile, when the boys find out what it means to be circumcised they try to save Ike from his Bris.

When a series of backyard pool homicides are reported in California, the BAU team team searches for an UnSub with a puzzling past.

Prentiss faces her past when the BAU is sent to investigate the murders of prominent businessmen, all of whom are missing their hearts. Also, Prentiss plans a romantic first date with Mendoza, but the evening is cut short by an urgent call from Rossi.
The BAU searches for an UnSub who may be fascinated with medical experimentation.
Mysterious drowning deaths discovered in the Las Vegas desert have the BAU trying to figure out the true cause and motive for the murders.

The BAU is called to Wisconsin in search of a serial killer, and the team looks for a connection among the victims for clues to the UnSub. Also, Kate has trouble dealing with her niece, Meg, when she begins acting out.
When an 18-year-old girl escapes from a suburban home where she was held captive for years with two other women, the BAU searches for the Unsub who kidnapped them.

programmes.d: The training camp candidates hold their breath as the one and only Kitty Carter pays a visit to training camp.  Kitty takes no prisoners as she rips into the new girls as well as the vets.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: With their futures on the line, the training camp candidates try to push through their heightened emotions to show Kelli and Judy they deserve to be part of America's Sweethearts.  Unfortunately, for some "Tonight will be your last night".

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: This is it, the last chance, as the girls finally learn their fate. Dreams start coming true as the girls pose for Squad Photo.  There is some great dancing as Show Group and the rest of the squad perform for the first time at a new "Meet The Team" event.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Begin the journey to see who will survive the most demanding dance audition in professional sports. 500 ladies put their dreams on the line as they try to become a famed Dallas Cowboys Cheerleader, for the 2014-2015 season.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: With 55 high caliber girls making it to finals, it's intimidating for the 30 veterans as they join the audition process & must fight to keep their place. Kitty Carter takes no prisoners as she prepares girls for their solos.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: As training camp begins with 43 ladies, the pressure starts to build!  Kelli's passion is infectious and intimidating in First Meeting, as she sets the expectations very high.  Seven girls will be cut to make a squad of 36.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Fear takes over for the new Training Camp Candidates as they face the reality of doing the DCC kick line & jump splits for the first time. Dreams come true if only temporarily, as the girls try on the uniform for the first time.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: To be a DCC, you need to look like a DCC.  This week Kelli makes sure all the girls have the look.  The final rehearsal of the week brings emotions to the forefront as a girl gets sent home.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: As the candidates enter the sixth week of training camp they need to start looking like a DCC or their spot is in jeopardy.  Melissa Rycroft and former DCC Tina Kalina sit in for Judy and give Kelli some fresh eyes.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: With three girls left to cut and the first game around the corner, the pressure is intense as the girls return to AT&T Stadium to take the field for the first time since auditions.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The final day of training camp has everyone nervous because Kelli and Judy might take a squad of less than 36.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: This season 400 hundred girls that have dared to dream they can become a world-famous Dallas Cowboys Cheerleader, put it all on the line, as preliminary auditions for the 2015-2016 season begin.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Talent and looks alone won't get you on the squad.  Dreams are made and hopes are crushed as only 46 out of 59 candidates make it into Training Camp.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: As Training Camp starts Kelli lays down the law.  Girls start to crack as the reality of how hard it is to become a DCC sets in.  Melissa Rycroft offers hope and advice on how to make it through.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Kelli and Judy must cut 10 girls to get to the magic number of 36 for the squad. Uniform Fittings gives Kelli a better idea of who has the whole package.  As the cuts begin so does emotional end of dreams.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: As the girls get the DCC look, it helps some and not others.  Two surprise guests stop by rehearsal and rock the DCC's world.  Kelli has one of the most awkward office visits of all time.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Cameos and Show Group auditions push the new girls and vets to their limits. Melissa Rycroft tries to save a DCC that's hanging by a thread and there is a shocking outcome from a Kelli office visit.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Emotions are supercharged as Kelli & Judy make a lot of tough cuts to keep up the quality of the team.  Melissa Rycroft offers invaluable field experience.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Kelli finally announces the squad. Injuries threaten the opening of Cowboys training camp.  Game Day chaos endangers a flawless performance.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Hundreds of beautiful and talented hopefuls arrive to try out for the best cheerleading team in the world, while many of the returning girls are looking for redemption. New judges increase the pressure of moving on to Finals.

programmes.d: Flavor Flav wants a girl who knows how to move.

programmes.d: Flavor Flav and all 20 of the Flavorettes from season 2 are back for a reunion show like you've never seen before.

programmes.st: Don't Threaten Me with a Good Time
programmes.d: Bret Michaels, lead singer of rock band Poison, welcomes 25 young ladies to his rocker lair in the hopes of finding that one special girl he can call his own.

programmes.t: Rock of Love: Talk Dirty to Me
programmes.d: With 16 girls all fighting for Bret's affection, tensions are run high and alliances are formed as the ladies try to eliminate each other from the competition for Bret's heart, it's Good Girls versus Bad Girls.
Bret challenges the twelve remaining girls to put the pedal to the metal in a motocross relay race, as they learn to ride, they fall, nearly run people over, and even lose an acrylic nail or two.

programmes.t: Rock of Love: Riff it Good
programmes.d: Bret wants a woman with a creative side, so he splits the remaining 10 women in teams of 2 for a music challenge, where the girls write lyrics to one of Bret's tracks then perform the song on stage.

programmes.t: Rock of Love: First Annual Bret's Mudbowl
programmes.d: Eight girls remain and Bret wants to see who's willing to get down-n-dirty for him in the First Annual Bret's Mudbowl!

programmes.t: Rock of Love: Tour Bus Challenge
programmes.d: The next test is The Tour Bus Challenge where the ladies compete in various challenges all relating to the life on the road, the winner getting a solo date.

programmes.t: Rock of Love: Show Me Your Hits
programmes.d: This week Bret has arranged for his remaining sexy six to shoot an album cover for his latest release.
Bret is down to his fabulous five and he's getting serious about finding the right girl so he calls on three of his super fans to interrogate the ladies, and choose the girl they think is best.

Cesar teams up with horse whisperer Pat Parelli to improve the behavior of the dogs and horses at a riding center; a schnauzer/poodle mix with separation anxiety and dog aggression.
Old and new cases that show the process for adopting a dog, introducing one to the home, setting rules and boundaries and dealing with the loss of a pet.

When young Pablo loses his magic flute, a terrible drought hits his family's farm. Dora and Boots find Pablo's flute and hurry off to return it to Pablo on his mountain.
Dora and Boots keep running into friends in need of help. Turns out the other animals are all headed to a big party at the Treehouse. They beg Dora and Boots to come too!
Boots is thrilled to hear about the riddle contest today at the Tall Mountain. Who can solve the silliest riddle?
Uh oh! A big storm cloud is coming. Dora and Boots have to warn all their friends in the forest to get home fast so the big storm cloud doesn't rain on them and get them wet.

Boots can't wait for a super-duper toy fire truck that's coming in the mail. But when the package arrives, the box is empty! Seems the toy fell out and is now sitting far away on top of Snowy Mountain.

The stick, the stick, the magic stick! Dora and Boots find a magic stick, and according to the wise old tree frog, it's up to our two young heroes to go to the top of the highest hill to make the stick do its magic trick.

¡Falta algo! Something's missing! Dora and Boots meet a wizard, El Encantador, who's missing his magic wand! Dora and Boots set off on an educational adventure to find El Encantador's wand so he can do his magic.
Squeaky, squeaky! What's that sound? It's Squeaky, Boots' adorably squeezable new bath toy. But when Boots loses Squeaky, we all have to head to the Gooey Geyser to get him back.
Meet Rojo, the newest, shiniest red fire truck. Rojo invites our heroes along as he goes on his very first rescue mission—to help a kitten who's stuck in a tree.

Who do we ask for help when we don't know which way to go?  The Map! But today the Map gets mistaken for a stick by a goofy bird. The bird flies Map all the way to his nest on top of Tallest Mountain.
It's Mother's Day, and Dora wants to help Papi bake Mamá a special cake. But three key ingredients are missing: bananas, nuts, and chocolate.
Go, go, go, Golden Explorers! Dora and her friends have formed a soccer team and are playing the big dinosaurs. Can Dora kick the ball into the net and score a goal?
¡Feliz Navidad! It's Christmas Eve, and Dora and Boots are going all the way to the North Pole to deliver a present to Santa.
Achoo, achoo! What's that sound? Benny the Bull has the sneezes. It's Doctor Dora to the rescue as she sets off for Benny's barn for a house call.

Yee haw! Cowgirl Dora and Cowboy Boots are riding through the Wild West on Pinto, the Pony Express. They have to deliver a special package of cowboy cookies to Benny the Bull. But they'll have to be on the lookout for Swiper.

Dora and Boots meet León, a friendly lion who wants to join the circus. They pedal on a unicycle, tightrope walk, and skate their way to the Big Top so León can become a circus lion and do all his tricks.
Step right up and join the fiesta! Dora and Boots are trying to win the grand prize—the Big Piñata! They need to collect 10 yellow tickets by playing carnival games and rides.
Nothing can stop Dora and Boots; they will not fail! Their job is to deliver the mail! Dora and Boots are mail carriers, and they need to deliver all the letters, even one to Swiper the Fox!

Map finds a red cape and becomes a superhero for the day. He can jump, he can fly, he can blow clouds away with a single, super breath! He's Super Map! When Dora's mommy calls her home, Dora and Boots need to get home fast.
Dora has tried and tried, but she's never been able to climb all the way across the monkey bars. Dora and Boots set off for Play Park so Dora can give it another try.
C'mon and join the musical parade! Dora and Boots are leading a parade over the Piano Bridge and through the Swinging Gate to free the instruments that were locked up by the evil Señor Shhh!
Dora and her friends are super good at hiding, especially Señor Tucán when he hides in the Rain Forest. If we can find all 8 friends, Señor Tucán promises to introduce us to his new baby toucans.

Finding the animals—that's a good trick! If you see an animal, aim and say, "Click!" Dora the photographer and her assistant, Boots, set off with a new camera to take pictures of wild animals for a photo contest.
Dora and Boots are on the hunt for cascarones—special eggs with confetti and prizes inside.

Dora and Boots are Super Spies on a top-secret mission: they have to stop Swiper from swiping Isa's cupcakes. Spy gadgets—everything from rocket sneakers to a Swiper detector—will help them find their way.
Boots is visiting Dora's classroom when they notice that the school pet, a cute and cuddly hamster named Mimo, is missing from his cage. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to rescue him!
"Happy Birthday to you," plays the Birthday Balloon as it floats by high in the sky. There's going to be a birthday party—but whose birthday is it?

When Dora and Boots color in a picture of Mami Duck and her eggs, their coloring book magically comes to life, and the eggs start to hatch. Suddenly, the wind blows one of Mami Duck's eggs away. Oh no!
Mary had a Little Lamb, but now Little Lamb is lost.  Dora and Boots jump into a big book of Nursery Rhymes to bring Little Lamb back to her best friend, Mary.

Calling all trucks!  Boots sure loves trucks.  When Ice Cream Truck gets stuck in the muck at Play Park, Dora and Boots are off to the rescue.  Boots uses his truck phone to call his other truck friends for help along the way.
What are we going to do?  Cockledoodledoo!  Dora and Boots help their friend, Red Rooster, get to the Highest Hill so he can wake up the Sun.  Along the way we practice making lots of noise.
Dora and Boots meet Roberto, a very cool robot with a tool belt, flashing lights, stretching powers, and super strength. But Roberto's lost!

Benny the Bull finds a magic wand and turns himself into a potato by mistake. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring their potato friend back to the Young Wizard so that he can change Benny back into a bull again.

Blast into outer space as Dora and Boots set off to bring stranded space creatures back home to the Purple Planet. Take a wild ride on a rocketship, travel through the Milky Way, and catch a ride on a comet.
Dr. Mike must choose between her fears of possibly infecting her unborn baby and her desire to help a mysterious stranger carrying a dreaded disease.
Dr. Mike tries to save the life of a young soldier shot during a scuffle between the army and the Indians.
Sully is injured trying to rescue Cloud Dancing from the Army.
Dr. Mike goes into labor in the wilderness, and her baby is born.
Dr. Mike leads a rescue party when Sully and Cloud Dancing are among the passengers in a massive train wreck.
Dr. Mike considers giving up medicine as she tries to cope with being a wife, mother and career woman.
When a baby dies under Dr. Mike’s care, she is sued for malpractice.
When a famous singer comes to town, Dr. Mike fears that Colleen may surrender her dream of becoming a doctor.
Prejudice comes to Colorado Springs as Dr. Mike and Sully try to help a young Latin-American woman when her husband is killed.
Dr. Mike is faced with the prospect of leaving Colorado Springs when Sully is offered a job surveying the new Yellowstone National Park.
Jake and Preston each want Dr. Mike’s endorsement when they run against one another for mayor -- until she is arrested.
Dr. Mike tries to reunite a father and son before it's too late.
Dr. Mike, Sully and Matthew join forces with a legendary marshal to track down the outlaws who wounded Matthew during a robbery.
Colorado Springs prepares for Thanksgiving, unaware of a deadly approaching storm that could destroy the town.
Dr. Mike, Sully and Brian must deal with the town’s prejudice when a black child tries to attend the all-white school.
Dr. Mike’s patients begin dying mysteriously.
Brian suffers a crisis of faith when the Rev. Johnson is stricken with progressive blindness at Christmas time, despite the healing efforts of Dr. Mike.

Krystle discovers damaging information regarding Alexis' marriage to Cecil Colby, Leslie follows Sean to his father's grave, learning his true identity as Joseph Aynders' son; Dana returns to Adam and the two quietly forget the past.

Forced by Adam and Fallon's vote, Steven reluctantly agrees to authorize the Vitron oil deal, as Sean's maniacal scheme to avenge his father's death begins to unfold; Krystle obtains a copy of Cecil Colby's original will.

Encouraged by her popular support after the shooting, Alexis decides to stay in the race; Sean speeds up his plan to use the Vitron oil deal to crush Alexis; Karen is unnerved by the return of her ex-husband.

Tired of Leslie's threats to expose his true identity, Sean plants a poisonous snake in her room as a warning of who she is dealing with; having second thoughts about accepting Adam's bribe to stay away from Karen, Jesse gives the money back.

Karen is rushed to the hospital as she goes into labor; after Sean threatens Leslie, she confides in Dex, Sean's true identity; Dex warns Alexis that Sean may be seeking vengeance against her as she listens in horror.
Alexis warns Blake about Sean's true identity. Concerned for his family's safety, Blake and Dex go to Natumbre to uncover Sean's mysterious scheme involving the Vitron oil deal.
Following the explosion in Natumbre, Blake is accused of dealing in illegal arms; Alexis uncovers proof that Sean paid Jesse to return to Denver so he could persuade Karen to keep Adam's baby.

Dana tries desperately to convince Adam how much she wants their son. She proposes that if they were a loving couple again, the judge would find in their favor. Still hurting from her outburst in court, Adam is cold to her pleas.
Adam is absolved of suspicion in the kidnapping of his son when Leslie calls him to say that Sean has taken the baby and is holding her captive. Adam and Steven hurry to the desolate mountain cabin.

Following Sean's death, Alexis is comforted by Dex's solace and friendship, as the two renew their passionate love for each other; Jeff and Sammy Jo are horrified to find her diary and a dead body in the water.

Sammy Jo and Jeff are relieved when they discover the body found floating in the lake is not Krystle; Blake's fears increase when Krystle's car is found and the man arrested for stealing it is a convicted murderer.
Enjoying his time with Krystle in Dayton, Blake remains perplexed by the case of her memory lapses.

Blake gives Jeff one-third controlling interest in Denver-Carrington, postponing Adam's plans to gain sole control of the company; Blake and Krystle meet with Dr. Hampton to begin tests, while Blake tells her the true reason for her severe headaches.
Suspecting her accountant has worked with Sean to ruin Colbyco, Alexis faces the reality she may lose her empire; receiving bad news from her doctor, Krystle asks Fallon to gather the family.

Surrounded by those she loves, Krystle resolves to live; Fallon takes the picture of Blake and the dead man to the morgue, unaware she is being watched; Accusing Blake of killing him twenty-five years ago, Alexis vows to avenge his death.

Interpreting Alexis' vendetta against Blake as a love/hate relationship, Dex tells Alexis he is through being taken for granted by her; Sammy suspects Virginia may not be as naive as she wants people to think.

Krystle agrees to have her operation, but only after Blake signs her divorce papers and living will, to be enacted if the surgery is not a success; Fallon is haunted by recurring dreams of Roger Grimes.
A wealthy businessman disappears from a five-star hotel.
A 5-year-old boy goes missing while his grandmother baby-sits.
Realizing what it takes to become professional dance squad; Rigo has questions after Eart-o's death.
The rivalry between Tal and Zo comes to a head; Davis meets Odalie's parents.
Nine and King work to take Rigo's music to the next level; Rigo's connections to the street scene continue to weigh on his music and his relationship with Poppy.
Dancers are unable to let go during an erotic dance and Sage demands that they go out in search of their sensuality; things heat up between Dondre and Poppy; Sage and Rigo compete.

As Nine encourages Sage to moderate his ambitions, Colette takes him on a journey into the past, to rediscover his artistic origins; Odalie finds it difficult to find balance in her love life and dance; Zo takes Tal out to have a fun night.

Tal discovers a terrible family secret; Sage and the dancers develop a new and risky concept; Nine helps Rigo deal with his feelings for Poppy, while Poppy and Dondre confront their own feelings for each other.

With Calvary's imminent demolition, Lady Mae and Bishop seek a sign from God; Jacob digs into the family mansion's past; Grace learns the real reason why Bob Whitmore is so invested in keeping the Calvary congregation under his wing.

Noah returns to assist Grace with AJ; Bishop and Lady Mae explore Mavis' club as a venue, rekindling memories; Jacob uncovers a startling truth about the Greenleaf house's past, shaking the family's foundations.
Grace is torn between pursuing Bob Whitmore's past and her family; Lady Mae and Bishop face challenges to their seedling dream of a new church; Jacob makes a discovery about the mansion's history.

Grace discovers a key informant during her investigation into Edenvale Lending; Charity's desire to honor the church's past may threaten her future within it; Bishop decides to take the issue of the house into his own hands.

Holding a small service at home, the Greenleaf family contemplates its future and what it might mean to start over; Noah shares an insight into the house's history; Lady Mae goes to see Tara James and returns with a startling revelation.

Bishop reels from the return of an old enemy, pushing Lady Mae to unveil a family secret; Charity makes Phil face his past, while Grace and Darius learn the shocking truth about Bob Whitmore and Edenvale Lending.

It's the Greenleafs versus Harmony and Hope, and neither will go down without a fight; Grace fights to stop the demolition; Lady Mae tries to negotiate for the mansion, but a reveal about the original owner prompts Bishop to a revelation of his own.

The AUSA turns up the heat on Ghost and implicates his inner circle in a RICO; Ghost and Tommy plan to frame Dre for the murder of Raymond Jones, Raina's killer; Angela and Tasha enact a plan of their own.

The Angels help a determined geneticist who is set on cloning a child from the DNA of Albert Einstein.

The creators of Kill Zone take action to the next level with a breakthrough combination of hard-hitting mixed martial arts battles and nail-biting tension.

'Panthergeist': The Panther is assigned to remove a fastidious ghost from a castle. 'Pinky's Pending Pink Slip': The Panther has to think up new ways to teach biology to a problem student without the Principal catching him breaking the rules.

'The Three Pink Porkers': The Panther's bed and breakfast is besieged by a trio of pigs that go hog-wild. 'The Heart of Pinkness': The Panther must make sure one of his river boat passengers isn't eaten by the legendary Varkzan of the jungle.
Scott's family album of werewolves gets mixed up in the back of Mick's car. He and his friend Stiles hunt it down in order to protect the Howard family secret.
A werewolf hunter comes to the town of Wolverton. Scott and his family must find and warn Grandpa, who is hunting turkey in the woods.

Whilst out snapping nature with his camera, Mr. Bean gets angry when nature snaps back. Inspired by a wildlife documentary on TV, Mr. Bean dusts off his camera and treks deep into the countryside in search of the perfect wildlife photograph.

Bean discovers that, in the world of organized crime, a teddy isn’t always a teddy. Sometimes it’s a rabbit.

Whilst browsing the supermarket for lovely grub, Mr. Bean’s life-long pal, Teddy, is kidnapped.

Mr. Bean can't find a parking space. So he makes one of his own.

Mr. Bean drives his favourite Teddy to the cinema to see his favourite
movie - 'Titanic'. Now he simply has to park the car. But when you're Mr
Bean, nothing's simple.

Whilst digging for buried treasure, Mr. Bean digs himself a hole too deep to get out of.

A local archaeology dig inspires Bean to go in search of treasure. But why buy a metal detector when you can make one from lawnmower parts and a dustbin lid?
When Sabrina hears that her Grandparents are coming for visit she is excited. They have a important announcement to make.
Everyone is fed up with Sabrina and Gem's constant rivalry. Sabrina casts a spell to make Gem and herself closer. But she uses too much potion and it causes them to stick together.
Sabrina makes a dreambike for Harvey, so he can beat the bully Slugloaf. Unfortunately the bike, Sheba, takes on a life of it's own with the intention of Winning no matter what.
Sabrina uses a little dash of mojo to win a bake off contest against Gem. Unfortunately whoever eats her upside down cake has their personality reversed.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: The Awakening
programmes.d: Cleo and Rikki face their final year of high school without Emma. They make a new friend in Bella and meet new boy Will – and encounter a strange new force on Mako Island that turns water against them.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Jungle Hunt
programmes.d: Will seeks confirmation of his first experience on Mako Island. Bella volunteers to misdirect his search so he won't find the Moon Pool. The girls and Lewis discover the Moon Pool has changed.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Keep Your Enemies Close
programmes.d: Cleo seeks a new job as an assistant dolphin trainer at the Marine Park. Rikki fires Nate's band from playing at the cafe until she and Bella reach an understanding.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Valentine's Day
programmes.d: Cleo is forced to put Lewis' plans for romance on hold to restrain Kim's out-of-control love life. During this time, Don meets Samantha, a National Parks manager, and they start dating.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Big Ideas
programmes.d: Zane concocts a dirt bike race to publicize the café. When Rikki discovers it's a scam, she and Bella decide to teach him and Nate a lesson. Cleo and Lewis make a major discovery about mixing the waters in the Moon Pool.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Secrets and Lies
programmes.d: Bella attempts to start a relationship with Will until she sees he's apparently got another girl. Lewis tests the magic Moon Pool water at school and attracts the attention of their Science teacher.
Gus has an incredible string of good luck culminating in his becoming the captain of the school's Soomer-crosse team. When Cassy becomes jealous of her pal's success.
When Gus and Cassy accidentally sit in Siege Perilous, the legendary throne of Galahad created by Merlin, they begin to return to their magical “roots.”
The ghost of a salty old captain has been regaling Gus with tales of traveling the seas. Consequently, Gus hasn't been studying for his mid-terms.
Verne arrives at his new boarding School in Hamburg for his first day and is horrified to discover that it is filled with all manner of magical beasts and beings!
A rainy day traps the girls inside. In an effort to play sick, the girls create a situation where their families become part of a dire medical emergency.
The full moon has come again, and the girls are taking every precaution they can imagine this time. It proves to be in vain, however, when Rikki falls under the spell.

Cleo and Kim are fighting like crazy and Cleo is pushed to breaking point. Then cousin Angela comes to stay and things just get worse. Cleo realises there are more challenging things than an annoying sister.
Lewis enters the annual fishing derby. When Cleo sees him struggling, she decides to help him out with disastorous consequnces. Meanwhile, Rikki and Zane are trapped on a hotel balcony.

Zane thinks Miss Chatham holds the key to the sea monster. Emma needs a change so dyes her hair red. While Zane gets closer to the secret, he also gets closer to Rikki. Zane dives to Miss Chatham’s boat and sees a mermaid!

Emma and Cleo find out Zane and Rikki are an item and force her to choose – him or them. When Zane appears to side with Harrison over the Mako island development Rikki’s decision is clear. Now it’s Zane’s turn to make a choice…

programmes.st: ATM with the Heart of Gold
programmes.d: Trouble ensues when Eerie's first automatic teller machine becomes obsessed with Simon.
In order to save his parents' marriage, Marshall must locate his dad's lost briefcase. During the search, Marhsall and Simon encounter yet another strange happening in Eerie.
Fourteen year old Erin has little else to do in her small town than to make up stories.
Gary is like any other 14-year old boy yearning for some privacy.
Randall loves to invent things, even if it means destroying other peoples belongings.
Vincent will stop at nothing to win.

Rip & Co. wing to Japan to investigate reports of a live Oni, the Japanese Demon.  They discover that the Oni report is a cover-up for something even more fantastic: the discovery of the magical Daruma Dolls.
While diving around an old shipwreck, Rip and Samantha have their yacht stolen on the high seas by the modern pirates.
Rip, Cyril, and Sam travel to Cairo, Egypt to investigate the case of a woman put in a coma by the Curse of King Tut, after trying to buy contraband artifacts from the dead Pharaoh's tomb.

Little Ricky is scheduled to play the drums in his first music school recital. Although his parents and the Mertzes are overcome with nervousness, Little Ricky seems calm until his big moment arrives, then goes to pieces.
Mario, the Ricardos' and Mertzes' gondolier in Venice, comes to New York to surprise his brother, but turns up at the Ricardos' apartment when he can't find him.

Lucy has misplaced her and Ethel's train tickets to Florida and they must share a ride with strange Mrs. Grundy. Mrs Grundy's odd behavior becomes more troubling to Lucy and Ethel when they learn that an escaped hatchet murderess matches her description.

While on vacation in Florida, Lucy and Ethel go on a shopping spree and spend a whopping $140! To make sure that their wives don't repeat their spree Ricky and Fred take the ladies on their next fishing trip.

Ricky and Fred are scheduled to judge a beauty contest but Lucy and Ethel plan for them to miss it. The four go out on a little cruise before the contest and Lucy has arranged for the boat's gas tank to be only half-filled.

Ricky and Fred are scheduled to judge a beauty contest but Lucy and Ethel plan for them to miss it. The four go out on a little cruise before the contest and Lucy has arranged for the boat's gas tank to be only half-filled.

The Ricardos and the Mertzes are cast in Little Ricky's school play when it runs short of cast members. Ricky plays a hollow tree, Lucy is the wicked witch, Fred plays the friendly frog, and Ethel is transformed in to the fairy princess.

Ricky insults Lucy's taste in hats so, as a joke, Lucy puts a loving cap trophy on her head that Ricky plans to present to champion jockey Johnny Longden at a National Turf Association dinner later that night. The trophy gets stuck on Lucy's head.

Little Ricky is turning 5 years old and Lucy had a party planned for Saturday, but Caroline Appleby is throwing a birthday party for her son Stevie on the same day. Neither mother is willing to change the date of their party.

Lucy and Ricky are determined to get rid of the puppy their son has brought home. They have a hard time overcoming Little Ricky’s arguments that it’s a welcome addition to a home that already boasts a parakeet, a frog, a lizard, a turtle and a goldfish.

programmes.st: Lucy Wants To Move To The Country
programmes.d: Lucy has become tired of living in the city and drops some none-too-subtle hints to Ricky that it would be nice to move to the country. Unbeknownst to her Ricky has already placed a comfortable deposit on a house in Westport, Connecticutt.

The Ricardos are anxious about their move to the country. Reality really sets in when Fred shows their apartment to a young couple. The Taylors will take the apartment but need to move in immediately.

The Ricardos get settled in their country home after all those years in a New York apartment and immediately begin to miss their old friends, Fred and Ethel. Lucy and Ricky decide to surprise the Mertzes with a visit.

programmes.st: Lucy Gets Chummy With The Neighbors
programmes.d: Wanting to replace their old furniture, Lucy gets an allowance of $500 from Ricky. Lucy goes overboard when she shops with their new neighbor Betty Ramsey, spending over three thousand dollars!

Although there are perks to living in their new country home, like House & Garden wanting to do a spread on them, the Ricardos find that it is expensive in Connecticut. Lucy decides to raise chickens and sell eggs as a moneymaking sideline.

The Ricardos and Mertzes, impatient with their egg selling business, decide that they must trade in their 500 chicks for 200 egg laying hens. However, after a couple of weeks, these hens don't yield many eggs at all.

Lucy decides to take part in the fund-raising campaign of the Westport Historical Society and offers to get her husband and his band to perform for their kickoff function. There's only one hitch – Ricky refuses to do it.

Lucy dreams of a night in New York City after spending six whole weeks in their new Connecticut home and it turns into a nightmare. Carefully hoarded tickets to a Broadway musical are supposed to take the Ricardos and the Mertzes to see the sold-out show.

Ethel is jealous of Lucy's friendship with neighbor Betty Ramsey. Sensitive to this, Lucy decides that the three of them should have a nice lunch together. Although reticent at first, Ethel opens up to Betty upon hearing they are both from Albuquerque.

Lucy must get vacationing Ricky out of her hair so she can do her housework. She and Ethel trick their husbands into building a brick barbecue on the Ricardo patio by first pretending to build it themselves.

The Ricardos and the Mertzes go with their neighbors, Ralph and Betty Ramsey, to the country club dance where a pretty visitor quickly convinces the men they are Romeos in disguise. They are each taken with Diana, the young beautiful cousin of a neighbor.

Suburbanite Lucy gets a green thumb and a competitive spirit. She has been raising tulips with a vengeance and wants to dethrone her neighbor Betty Ramsey for "Best Looking Garden" in the local garden club competition.

The town of Westport has commissioned a statue of a Minuteman to commemorate the Revolutionary War. The whole town is involved, from Fred who will serve as town crier to Ricky who will make the dedication speech.

programmes.st: The Girls Want to Go to A Nightclub
programmes.d: To celebrate the Mertzes' wedding anniversary, Fred and Ricky want to go to a prizefight, but the girls want to get dressed up and go to a nightclub. An argument ensues and Lucy threatens to find two other escorts if their husbands won't take them.

Lucy decides Ricky's love is growing cold so she takes Ethel's advice she learned from a book, How to Keep the Honeymoon from Ending. Her attempt to dress up for breakfast doesn't yield any response from Ricky.

One of the girls in Ricky's show quits, creating a vacancy which Lucy wants to fill. She goes down for an audition and can have the part provided she loses twelve ponds in four days to fit into the previous singer's size 12 outfit.

programmes.st: Lucy Thinks Ricky Is Trying To Murder Her
programmes.d: Lucy is reading "The Mockingbird Murder Mystery" when Ethel reads her fortune and tells her death is near. Later she overhears a conversation between Ricky and his agent and she jumps to the wrong conclusion that he's trying to do away with her.
When Ricky cuts off Lucy's allowance and charge accounts because of her careless spending, Lucy finds herself short of funds. Ethel has tickets to a radio quiz show that has a cash prize of $1,000.
Network television scouts are going to check out Ricky's band and Lucy tries to "get into the act" in order to be discovered as well. Of course Ricky will not hear of it.
Lucy becomes interested in numerology and advises Ricky that it is a good day for him to make any deals he can. However, she soon realizes that she consulted the horoscope from yesterday's newspaper.
When Ricky leaves his clothes around the living room, Lucy gets angry and divides the room in half so Ricky can be as messy as he likes - on his side!

Ricky brings home a $3,500 mink coat to be used in his nightclub act, and Lucy assumes it's her anniversary present. Trying to get the coat away from her becomes a problem because Lucy not only wears it while she does housework, she even sleeps in it.
Ethel Mertz interprets a gossip column item to mean that Ricky is interested in one of the chorus girls in his nightclub. Ricky assures Lucy that it's just publicity.

programmes.st: Ink Master Clash of the Collages
programmes.d: The South aims to unify and rebound when the teams are tasked with a postcard mural on the side of a bus, and a compass rose elimination tattoo includes a game-changing twist.

programmes.st: Ink Master Teamwork Makes the Dream Work
programmes.d: Teams must unify or die in a two-day tattoo marathon that's all about collaboration, then the losers fight for survival with full-bodied American traditional fairy tattoos.
To test legibility, the teams spin intricate designs with yarn on outdoor canvases, then get technical with schematic tattoos.

programmes.st: Ink Master Out of Your Element
programmes.d: To test their consistency, each team must work on a single canvas at the same time to create a tattoo series representing either earth, wind, water or fire.
After the teams create colorful murals by inserting cups into chain-linked fences, the artists are tasked with tattooing neon-light pieces.
The teams must prove their adaptability while they each work on multiple tattoos and canvasses at the same time, and the Face Off Tattoo comes with a surprise.
The teams put their knowledge of color theory to the test while concocting candy creations, and new school food is on the menu for the elimination tattoo challenge.

programmes.st: Ink Master Artistry On The Line
programmes.d: Competitors must win a suspended-art flash challenge for the right to assign canvases in the notoriously difficult pinup tattoo elimination.

programmes.st: Ink Master Every Artist for Themselves
programmes.d: The 10 remaining artists must set themselves apart from their regional teams and face off in head-to-head individual battles, and two competitors are sent home.

programmes.st: Ink Master From Toast to Toast
programmes.d: Jerrel is chafed by his team while creating a mural out of toasted bread, then the artists are tasked with tattooing realistic U.S. landmarks.
The artists must show their versatility and tattoo line drawings created by another contestant, but an unexpected twist shakes up an alliance's strategy.

programmes.st: Ink Master There Can Only Be One
programmes.d: Working solo to test their precision, the artists must create mural designs using only staples, then tattoo portraits of senior citizens.
The artists create one-of-a-kind designs on protective headgear in the Flash Challenge, and composition is key for a daunting elimination tattoo featuring Japanese cranes.

programmes.st: Ink Master Race to the Finish
programmes.d: Five artists must tattoo a subject and style chosen by their competitors in an elimination challenge, followed by a 13-hour tattooing marathon to send a second artist home.
With a chance to win $100,000 and the title of Ink Master, 10 of the world's best tattoo artists put their skills to the test.
Heather challenges the judges' critiques, a head tattoo becomes a medical emergency, and Ton Jones joins the panel as a guest judge.
The artists test their shading skills on naked female canvases during the Flash Challenge, Al rubs the other artists the wrong way, and one more artist is sent home.
A treasure stealing invisible demon appears. An old lady who failed to defeat him asks Inuyasha and the gang for help.
Akitoki, Hoji's ancestor is on a journey to offer the Hojo family heirloom, the Kenkon Naginata, a demon sword that brings disaster.

programmes.st: Mountain of Demons: Survival of the Duo
programmes.d: Akitoki and Inuyasha travel the shrine of the wind and thunder gods to make an offering to seal away the blade's demon powers.

programmes.st: The Great Duel at Shoun Falls!
programmes.d: Hoshiyomi uses the Kon blade to steal the Tessaiga's demon powers.

programmes.st: Eternal Love: The Naginata of Kenkon
programmes.d: Tsukiyomi, who is supposed to be dead, possesses Kagome and appears before Hoshiyomi.
Naraku's baby is bringing virtuous priests close to death and peering into their minds. He is trying to peer into the space between this world and the next.
Naraku's baby was split into two. One half comes back to life in the form of a child dressed in white.
Kanta is an otter demon child. His father's head was taken by Hakudoshi, and he is looking for his father's body.
The area between this world and the next, where Sacred Jewel shard is, is the demon graveyard where Inuyasha's father's corpse rests.

programmes.st: Bizarre Guards at the Border of the Afterlife
programmes.d: Inuyasha and the gang arrive in the land of fire. They discover a giant gateway within a cave in the mountains.

programmes.st: The Fiery Bird Master, Princess Abi
programmes.d: When the gateway in the Land of Fire opened, Kagome sensed the presence of the Sacred Jewel shard.

programmes.st: The Tragic Love Song of Destiny, Part 1
programmes.d: When Kikyo's younger sister, Kaede, was still a little girl, Kikyo entrusted her with a corrupt Sacred Jewel.

programmes.st: The Tragic Love Song of Destiny, Part 2
programmes.d: When Kikyo's younger sister, Kaede, was still a little girl, Kikyo entrusted her with a corrupt Sacred Jewel.
In order to defeat Naraku, Kagura looks for Sesshomaru. She appears before Rin and Jaken, but Sesshomaru is away.

programmes.st: The Mysterious Light that Guides the Saint
programmes.d: Kagome and the others sense Kikyo's presence from the purifying arrow. Meanwhile, Abihime attacks the village.

programmes.st: The Girl Who Overcame Time…and the Boy Who Was Just Overcome
programmes.d: In feudal Japan, the half demon Inuyasha was sealed away by the priestess Kikyo. Many years later he is revived by Kagome.
Kagome finds out that she may be the reincarnation of Kaede's late older sister, the priestess Kikyo, who sealed Inuyasha with her arrow.

programmes.st: Down the Rabbit Hole and Back Again
programmes.d: Kagome has the ability to see pieces of the Shikon Jewel. Inuyasha has the power to defeat demons. Both of their powers are needed to gather the shards of the jewel.
Kagome has returned to the present day and is relaxing in her home when Inuyasha comes looking for her. Some of Yura's demonic hair is on his body.
Kagome learns that Inuyasha is a half demon, born of a human mother and a dog demon.
The muonna makes Inuyasha reveal the location of his father's grave.
Kagome is able to pull out the Tetsusaiga. Sesshomaru tries to kill her, and Inuyasha is angered and fights to protect Kagome.

programmes.st: The Toad Who Would Be Prince
programmes.d: Nobunaga tries to save the lord of the castle who is possessed by a toad demon.
Shippo is a demon fox whose father was killed by the the Thunder Brothers: Hiten and Manten.

programmes.st: Phantom Showdown–The Thunder Brothers vs. Tetsusaiga
programmes.d: Inuyasha goes to save Kagome from Manten. Hiten devours the sacred jewel shard that Manten had and absorbs his demon powers.

programmes.st: Terror of the Ancient Noh Mask
programmes.d: Kagome has returned to the present day to take a test. As she does, a noh mask, the Mask of Flesh, begins a violent search for the Shikon Jewel shards.

programmes.st: The Soul Piper and the Mischievous Little Soul
programmes.d: Kagome sees a Soul Piper, a demon that consoles the spirits of children. She helps Mayu, a girl who is about to become an evil spirit, to pass on.

programmes.st: The Mystery of the New Moon and the Black-haired Inuyasha
programmes.d: Half demon Inuyasha's secret is that he becomes human once a month. That day, Inuyasha and the gang meet Nazuna and stay at a mountain temple.
The ogress, Urasue, robs the grave of Kikyo, the priestess who sealed away Inuyasha fifty years ago.

programmes.st: Return of the Tragic Priestess, Kikyo
programmes.d: Kikyo is revived when Kagome's soul flows into her. She tries to kill Inuyasha, but Kagome takes back her soul.

programmes.st: Mystical Hand of the Amorous Monk, Miroku
programmes.d: Miroku, a womanizing delinquent priest, has been collecting Shikon Jewel shards and steals Kagome's shards.

programmes.st: The Cursed Ink of the Hell-Painter
programmes.d: Kotatsu, a painter, sees a dream in which he becomes successful by controlling an army of ogres drawn with ink that has a sacred jewel shard in it.
Naraku appears before Sesshomaru and lends him an arm with a sacred jewel shard embedded in it.
When Jane is reunited with her first love, Adam (guest star Tyler Posey), she is shocked but happy to see him, however Xo and Alba are less thrilled that he is back.
Jane's new relationship with Adam helps bring out her fun side and reminds her that she isn't just a mom. However, when Adam gets a job opportunity and doesn't know if he should stay or go.
Jane and Adam's relationship seems to be moving at hyper-speed, and Jane thinks that it might be time for him to meet Mateo, but Rafael is not happy with this idea.
When Jane learns that Rafael introduced Mateo to his new girlfriend, Katherine, without her consent, she gets angry since she thinks Katherine has a negative influence on Rafael and Mateo.
When Adam reveals his dating past to Jane, the information puts a strain on their relationship.  Lina  seeks Jane's advice about whether she should get married.
Jane's book is finally being released but her plans to have a party at the local bookshop where she was inspired to be a writer hit a snag.
Jane is excited for her first book tour and brings Xo along for fun, but Alba decides last minute that she is going as well.
After Jane and Rafael decide to send Mateo to a new school, they become guilt-ridden when they are forced to lie to get him in.
Jane and Rafael realize that the uncertain state of their relationship is stressing out Mateo and they decide they need to make a decision.
Jane and Rafael try to be friends which works great until Jane goes on a date.  Petra and Jane's new partnership is off to a rocky start, but they know they have to find a way through it.
Jane is ready to move on from the Marbella and pursue writing full time, but an unexpected development forces her to consider returning to her teaching roots.
Jane's fixation on a negative review has left her with writer's block, so Rogelio suggests she take a class to help.
When Jane, Rogelio and Alba learn what is going on with Xo, they all try to comfort her, but Xo insists they let her live her life.
Xo struggles to make an important decision and looks to Jane for guidance leaving Rogelio feeling like an outsider.
After Jane, Rafael, Petra and JR all go out together, Jane is upset to learn that JR doesn't like her. Jane and Rafael brush off a big relationship moment, but they try to make up for it.
Jane and Rafael find themselves in a not ideal living situation in order to save money.  When Rafael sees Alba try to punish Mateo, an unexpected rift is formed.
Jane believes she and Rafael are in a good place until she realizes he is keeping a secret from her.  Alba's big day has finally arrived, and Jane, Xo and Rogelio are ready to celebrate.
Kathy is suing truck driver Doug for vehicular damages after claiming he illegally passed her on the right.

programmes.st: Wigging Out Over an Unpaid Loan

Nicole is suing the man she rented a room from after making her uncomfortable and changing the locks after a fight.
After Anthony claims he saw explicit text messages between the defendant and her ex, he's suing for unpaid loans.
Christina is suing someone she's known for 8 years over money she claims he owes her for a French bulldog.
Allison says her baby daddy rarely sees their child, and is she suing for the cost of ballet classes and medical bills.
Jane claims her ex-husband of 25 years owes her over $3,000 for their son's wedding.

programmes.st: You Threw Me Out Of Your Taxi
programmes.d: Allison is suing the taxi driver she hired to drive her home after a medical procedure for kicking her out.
Jennifer is accusing Michelle of causing the car crash and is suing her for the damages to her car.
Francis is being sued by his brother for over $4,000 because they claim it was money he promised to reimburse.
Donna says the defendants stored their old beat up RV on her property and they owe her money.
Andrew is accusing his ex boss of assault and demands retribution for his back pain after the attack.
Amanda is suing her nail tech Jonyell after paying for her to take a nail class but she breached their contract.
Irma demands a refund for the party bus she rented from LaToya, stating it wasn't decorated properly.
Chanel is suing her ex for a birthday gift and emotional distress after finding out he's been texting other women.
Arsenio is taking his ex-tenant to court after claiming she left the unit a mess including leaving two buckets of urine.

A girl discovers that she can see everyone's imaginary friends, and with this unique gift, she embarks on a magical journey to reconnect forgotten IFs with their kids. An adventure you'll need to believe to see, IF is perfect for the whole family.
In futuristic Metro City, scientist Tenma (voiced by Nicolas Cage) creates an amazing robot boy with hidden talents unlike anything you've ever seen.
When a take-charge alpha wolf and a laidback omega wolf get relocated halfway across the country, the two must set off on an incredible journey home in this CGI-animated adventure.

In a world filled with Mad Scientists and Evil Inventions, one talented evil scientist's hunch-backed lab assistant has big dreams of becoming a Mad Scientist himself and winning the annual Evil Science Fair.

In love with Marina, the most beautiful penguin in all the land, hopeless romantic Hubie must thwart the plans of his evil rival, Drake, and win Marina’s heart in this charming, animated adventure from the creators of "All Dogs Go To Heaven."
An animated film about a barnyard rooster (the voice of Glen Campbell) who goes to Las Vegas and finds success as an Elvis-impersonating nightclub singer.

A wonderful, song-filled feature about an unlovable, murdered mutt (Burt Reynolds) who returns to Earth to do a good deed. He adopts an orphan girl who can communicate with animals and helps lead him to his killer.

Charlie and Itchy are back! Those lovable mutts from the treasured Family hit "All Dogs Go To Heaven" return for an all-new Animated Musical Adventure. Features the voices of Charlie Sheen, Dom DeLuise and Sheena Easton.
The magical inhabitants of a rainforest fight to save their home, which is threatened by logging and a polluting force of destruction called Hexxus.
Three adventurous houseflies stow away on the Apollo 11 moon flight and are secret contributors to the mission's success. Animated fun voiced by Christopher Lloyd, Kelly Ripa, and more.
Jay, Kai and Nya find themselves in more danger while escaping the Administration, and the Ninja must defend the Whispering Wood during Lloyd's trial.
Sora and Frak must unmask the Loyalist in Umbrasylvis to clear their name. Meanwhile, Lloyd confronts his past inside the temple.

Viewing a heated argument from his hotel window, Matlock witnesses a murder involving two stars of a local theater production and an unhappy husband. When he helps investigate the case, his memory becomes a bit blurred.

Three high fashion cover girls are suspects in the death of a powerful agent who was stabbed to death in a famous photographer’s darkroom. Ben Matlock takes the case at the insistence of his investigator, Conrad McMasters.

When a renowned author is murdered, Matlock defends the accused – the subject of a biography the victim was writing – only to encounter a disturbing revelation about his client midway through the trial.

Director of an amateur stage production, Doug Michaels fires would-be actor Ben Matlock from his role as a detective, claiming he’s seen kumquats with more talent. However, the tables soon turn when Michaels is accused of murdering the leading lady.
Ben Matlock discovers a hornet’s nest of intrigue, ruthless business tactics and plenty of hanky panky when he defends Dave Travis, the Bad Boy of professional tennis.
Convinced that his brother was framed for murder, a psychopath is determined to get even and holds Matlock’s associates hostage.
Matlock discovers he has more than one tricky suspect to contend with as he tries to defend magician Daniel Fontaine who’s accused of murdering Sandy Farrell, his ambitious and unfaithful assistant.

The brutal murder of an ambitious, beauty contest hopeful taints the annual Reach for the Stars ceremonies. Matlock is reunited with an old girlfriend, Janet Masters, whose daughter, Morgan, is accused of the crime.

One of Ben’s old clients is charged with bank robbery, again. The only witness is a precocious twelve-year-old boy who presents more than a handful of problems for Matlock. One of them is the boy’s fee for helping out. He wants Matlock to defend his dad.

Ben Matlock discovers the private life of a personal trainer includes sizzling secrets that might shatter the reputations of several socialites. Harry Slade puts Casanova to shame, but it costs him his life.
Against Matlock’s approval, his associate, Cliff Lewis, advertises for a private client. He is hired by a flaky woman who becomes the main suspect in the murder of the plastic surgeon she sued.
A plastic surgeon’s murder leads Matlock into a chain of events and murder involving a wealthy family.

Matlock suspects foul play when a college basketball coach is accused of pay-offs, point-shaving, and murder. As tempers flare and accusations run wild, Matlock makes an enlightening discovery, the head of the booster club was bribing recruits

Matlock’s investigation as the state’s Special Prosecutor uncovers a judicial conspiracy involving two judges and a corporate lawyer.
Two nieces frame their uncle for their aunt’s murder.
A nurse is accused of murder.
Guest star Nehemiah Persoff as a corrupt Latin American official plots to loot his own country of $40,000,000 with the connivance of the IMF.

Guest star Mai (cq) Britt is a dangerous obstacle when the IMF sets out to learn the number of her husband's Swiss hank account by convincing him World War III has started on Paramount Television Is "Mission: Impossible."

The IMF is called upon to free John Darcy, the leader of a liberation movement in West Africa, and end the tyrannical rule of his captor, Colonel Alex Kohler, a ruthless segregationist in the "Kitara"
The IMF devises an elaborate scheme to dupe foreign agent James Reed into stealing a bogus missile guidance system in "The Missile"
Phelps poses as a government investigator who must work through a crooked district attorney to prove that a crime syndicate boss killed his girlfriend.

The Impossible Missions Force must end the murderous career of a bacteriologist working for the enemy, who has succeeded in developing a mutant strain of a deadly bacteria which could be used as a practical battlefield weapon.
The resurgence of neo-Nazism in Germany takes the IMF to Bavaria, where Marcus von Frank (Hans Gudegast) threatens to become a second Hitler.

Singer Barbara McNair guest stars as Jena Cole, the beautiful leader of a band of jewel thieves who falls in love with Barney who himself has infiltrated her operation to recover the stolen crown jewels of a foreign nation.
The IMF sets out to destroy a murder-for-hire organization.
Henry Darrow guest stars as Gregory Tolan, the local leader of a revolutionist group specializing in robberies for the financing of a movement to overthrow the United States government in the "Blast"

The Impossible Missions Force, led by Jim Phelps (Peter Graves) enters Equatorial Africa to crush an army of mercenaries, led by a self-styled colonel, and to return plundered gold to its rightful owners.
Anastas Poltroni is the head of an international narcotics syndicate, and has taken refuge in a country with no extradition treaty. The IM Force is assigned to lure him out.

Before a statute of limitations expires on a 10-million dollar robbery, the Impossible Missions Force must spring the suspect from prison and dupe him into leading police to the hiding place of the money.
The IMF is assigned to recover microfilm plans for manipulating international gold reserves.

To head off a threatened atomic blast, Jim Phelps gains entry to a top secret nuclear plant by posing as a temperamental artist with guest star Barbara Luna as his model on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

A dog that collects rare stamps -- on command from the IMF -- figures in a perilous journey to the stronghold of a narcotics kingpin (guest star Fernando Lamas) on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."
The IMF goes to the aid of a friendly South American government which has been overthrown by revolutionaries.

Mister Rogers tells viewers that there are many different kinds of food. Food for the eyes, for the ears, and for the spirit.

Mister Rogers shows a film of a bird family, and an origami artist demonstrates how to make paper birds and puppets. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, a puppet couple, Betty and James, adopt a baby daughter.

Mister Rogers visits pediatrician Dr. Jane Breck, who shows young viewers what might happen during a child's routine checkup. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, Cousin Mary Owl plans a cousin reunion!

Mister Rogers talks about how children are curious about families that are formed by adoption and talks about his family's adoption of his own sister. He shows a film about different families in his Neighborhood.

programmes.st: Families: A Field Trip to See the Penguins

programmes.st: Making & Creating: Many Different Ways to Play

programmes.st: Making & Creating: Learning to Make Chinese Dumplings
programmes.d: At Chef Brockett's bakery, Eva Kwong's grandmother makes special Chinese dumplings, and Mister Rogers talks about how children can learn about so many things from adults.

programmes.st: Making & Creating: How Wooden Rocking Horses Are Made
programmes.d: Mister Rogers shows how people make wooden rocking horses. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, Mr. Aber gets a mask that makes him look like King Friday, and the Neighbors talk about the importance of making and keeping friends.

programmes.st: Making & Creating: A Kitten Is Born
programmes.d: Mister Rogers shows viewers a kitten named Jimmy and a film of Jimmy's birth, and assures viewers that "it's all right to wonder about things." Then, poet and essayist May Sarton visits.

programmes.st: Making & Creating: Bob Leathers - Playground Designer
programmes.d: Mister Rogers invites viewers along on a visit to a special new playground designed and built by both adults and children. He makes up a song at the piano.

programmes.st: Visit a Factory to See Trikes Made
programmes.d: Mister Rogers visits a toy factory where people make plastic molded tricycles, and he receives a visit from folk singer Ella Jenkins who collects toy tops from around the world.

programmes.st: Mister Rogers Flies a Toy Plane
programmes.d: Mister Rogers flies a balsa wood airplane, and Mr. McFeely visits an airport control tower. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, Prince Tuesday discovers that learning to ride a bike isn't always easy!

Mister Rogers shows how empty containers plus some imagination can create a whole Neighborhood. In Make-Believe, Ana Platypus is jealous of Prince Tuesday's new bike and angry because her parents aren't buying one for her.

programmes.st: Visit to a Toy Lending Library
programmes.d: Mister Rogers visits a toy lending library and sees children playing with different kinds of toys. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, Prince Tuesday learns to ride his bike, and also learns to share it!

programmes.st: Things to Do Inside When It Rains
programmes.d: Mister Rogers arrives with a raincoat and talks about things to do inside. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, Lady Aberlin dances in the rain. X flies to slide down a rainbow. Daniel wants to learn Tai Chi to stop his scary dreams.

Mister Rogers hangs a fish mobile, then goes to see some killer whales swim and play. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, Lady Elaine teaches dance and says males weren't invited to the studio because they don't dance.

programmes.st: Mister Rogers Watches Sam Weber Dance
programmes.d: Mister Rogers visits Sam Weber and sees him dance. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, King Friday XIII goes to Lady Elaine's dance school, and she turns him away claiming that men can't dance. Sam Weber arrives and dances.

Mister Rogers helps to weave a scarf. Henrietta Pussycat's ballet teacher, Miss Cloud, does not speak but communicates with movement. The Junior Tamburitzans perform two folk dances. Mister Rogers talks about making up stories and dances.
Mister Rogers, with the help of his ventriloquist dummy, learns that sign language and talking can be two different ways of saying the same thing.

The team works to solve the murder of a dog that was left a $20 million estate by its deceased owner, with the help of a wannabe detective (ANDREW DALY - The Closer).

Gibbs and the team investigate when a weekend call to an NCIS tip line results in the death of two agents. The NCIS team discovers a tip about terrorist activity was a trap that resulted in the death of two agents.

Director Shepard takes a huge risk and agrees to meet an informant alone about Le Grenouille, but the meeting goes bad and her contact is killed.
Gibbs and the team investigate when a blind photographer inadvertently captures the murder of a petty officer on file.
