programmes.t: The Best of Chronicle: Main Streets and Back Roads
programmes.d: “The prettiest village in Maine.” That’s how a writer once described Wiscasset, a coastal enclave in mid-coast Maine. Tonight Nicole Estaphan takes in the spectacular views and meets the people who call this historic village home. She makes a whistle stop at the local train museum; visits a lush lavender farm; and stops by a yoga retreat where she communes with the resident alpacas. And before leaving town Nicole meets a local baker whose key lime pie one food writer called the best – ever.

Winter weather is still in our forecast, and we have the warm and cozy menu to match! Chicken and dumplings. Shrimp and grits. Mac and cheese. Darryl’s Corner Bar and Kitchen in Roxbury whips up Southern comfort food staples, and we cozy up to the hearth at Hunter’s Kitchen and Bar in South Boston. Erika Tarantal carbo-loads with warm, savory English muffins at Vinal Bakery in Somerville, while in Cambridge we indulge in heaps of ramen and Thai home cooking. Plus – what’s not to like about an ap

Winter is coming...and while winter farming sounds like an oxymoron, growing, cultivating, and selling produce still happens during the coldest months of the year. Tonight, we visit a winter CSA selling produce year-round, a fifth-generation farm specializing in winter grain-making, and a greenhouse restaurant at Natick’s Lookout Farm. We’ll also meet a farmer from the Azores who settled in Massachusetts and is now helping other immigrant farmers.
The latest news, weather, and sports from the WCVB NewsCenter 5 Team.

Bundle up! Tonight, Anthony Everett is taking us out for a cold-weather version of “On the Water.” He heads out on the chilly waters of New Hampshire’s Great Bay, where UNH researchers are studying the behavior of oysters.

The Nutcracker is back! So are big theatrical movie releases and live theater performances, after a pandemic-related hiatus. Tonight, Shayna Seymour sashays through Boston Ballet’s costume shop and meets dancers preparing for a return to live performances. Boston movie critic Ty Burr joins us for some Oscar talk, highlighting 2021 Academy Award contenders, and Nicole Estaphan sits down with Grammy-winning bassist Esperanza Spalding to discuss her work on a groundbreaking new opera, Iphigenia.
Chronicle's award-winning team brings you the stories of New England.

Looking for some entertainment? Tonight we bring you a taste of the musicals, movies, and arts performances on tap this holiday season and winter. Shayna Seymour meets a Berklee grad and one of the “queens” from the rock musical, “Six,” and we check on other stage performances including a new theater company, The Front Porch Arts Collective. Movie critic Ty Burr gives us a rundown of the Academy Award contenders, and Shayna Seymour goes behind the scenes of The Boston Ballet’s “The Nutcracker.”

California has Napa Valley. New England has…more wine than you might think! Our region is home to 600 vineyards and countless stories of winemakers and wine innovators. Shayna Seymour boards a renovated school bus for a wine tour along the North Shore. We visit a pop-up wine bar in an old shipping container in Boston’s Fenway neighborhood; make a stop on Connecticut’s official Wine Trail, at Taylor Brooke Winery, where the business is all in the family; and meet a local artist who custom-paints

programmes.d: Anthony Everett visits scenic Windsor County, Vt., during “shoulder season.” We begin in Woodstock, visiting the charming Woodstock Inn and Marsh-Billings-Rockefeller National Historic Park. In nearby Bridgewater, Anthony meets furniture maker Charles Shackleton (a cousin of explorer Sir Ernest Shackleton - he of lost ship “Endurance” fame). Anthony ventures over the county line to Randolph, where he meets a Thai chef now gaining a national reputation. And back in West Windsor, home to Ascutney

programmes.t: The Best of Chronicle: Main Streets and Back Roads
programmes.d: Wooded beauty, winter quiet, and a deep sense of community - Ted Reinstein finds it all in this collection of small towns in the southeast corner of the Green Mountain State. He hits Peru, Jamaica, and Athens - just a few of the more peculiar place names in northern New England – and meets the couple who have revived a beloved general store. Ted also ventures a bit outside Windham County to hit the slopes at Bromley Mountain, a New England leader in adaptive skiing.
Chronicle's award-winning team brings you the stories of New England.

Press a button and anything you want will appear. This may sound like a scene from the 1960s cartoon, The  Jetsons, but this is life in 2021. Popular delivery apps report growth of more than 100% year to year, and now, local businesses are getting into the on-demand game: gourmet cupcakes, pet groomers, mechanics, and haircuts that come right to you.

New England wouldn’t be New England without the shore birds, butterflies, and turtles that spend part of the year here. These and other local creatures are considered “indicator species” that also help us understand the impact of habitat loss and climate change. Tonight we get up close to giant sea turtles and tiny terrapins, whimbrels and piping plovers, and meet the people committed to protecting them.
From head to toe, wool is an indispensable fiber and tonight we meet local shepherds, sheep, shearers (and sheep dogs!) as we explore the wool trade in New England.
As America celebrates its 250th anniversary, we explore places, businesses, foods, and traditions that are even older than the nation itself.
Chronicle's award-winning team brings you the stories of New England.

A trophy case under the Longfellow Bridge, and a steampunk museum inside a central Mass. church? Who knew! They’re just two of the quirky stories that Ted Reinstein uncovers tonight. Ted heads inside a local stove hospital (just what it sounds like) and the Volleyball Hall of Fame (can you guess where it is?). He meets a local man who makes baseballs…by hand…and visits a Cambridge candy shop that has a “sweet” collection of confectionery memorabilia.
If you’re craving gingerbread, Christmas cookies, chocolate babka, or even gluten-free holiday treats, tonight we have you covered.
Chronicle's award-winning team brings you the stories of New England.

programmes.t: Game Gone Wild: The Socker Slam Story
programmes.d: A stranger than fiction documentary that chronicles a semi-scripted extreme sporting league that premiered in 2000. Socker Slam took elements of wrestling, rugby and “butts up” shenanigans and body slammed them into a soccer drama.

(2022) The disappearance of Johnny Gosch is one of Iowa's longest running, and most notorious mysteries. In 1982, the 12-year-old paperboy in West Des Moines vanished without a trace. Forty years later, KCCI uncovers where the investigation stands.

If you ride the Red Line you have likely passed through Andrew Station in Dorchester. But, who was “Andrew?” Ted Reinstein uncovers both Andrew’s identity and a secret hidden within a painting of the man: call it, two “who knew” stories in one! Also tonight, more little-known stories from around our area including a highway underpass in Boston transformed into a gallery of murals by world renowned artists and a local take on the sea shanty craze on Tik-Tok.

Roll with us tonight as we find stories balanced on two wheels, four wheels, and wheels made famous in Hollywood. Erika Tarantal cruises East Boston in an old-fashioned surrey (with the fringe on top), then works out with a mobile personal trainer. We go “Back to the Future” to tour a collection of famous cars housed in a central Mass. warehouse, then meet a mechanic who tends lovingly to Edsels, Nashes, and other “orphan cars.” Anthony Everett raises a pint inside a pub on wheels, and it’s Chri

Think Bigfoot’s a big joke? Talk of UFOs make you glaze over? Tonight we’re talking to people who say – keep an open mind! We wander the woods with members of “Squatchachusetts” who are hot on the pursuit of information on the (could it be?) existence of Bigfoot. Anthony Everett boards the historic USS Salem in Quincy, where a paranormal investigator gives him the grand tour. And for anyone looking for evidence of UFOs or alien life, Anthony talks to a Harvard astrophysicist who researches poten

Shayna Seymour is back with another round of what’s new and - given the weather - what’s hot! Shayna sits down (and sings) with Broadway megastar Kristin Chenoweth, whose new musical, The Queen of Versailles, opens in Boston this week.

It’s another round of what’s fun, informative, entertaining – and new! Shayna Seymour visits a Boston café that is fulfilling patrons’ wishes, while a Newbury Street shop helps shoppers make their design dreams come true.
Start your engines! Tonight Shayna Seymour is racing around in search of all things new, fun, and delicious.

Shayna Seymour’s back on the hunt for new things to do, see, eat – and watch! Shayna indulges in an over-the-top dinner at 311 in Boston, and samples outrageous desserts at the new Sugar Factory in Quincy Market.
Building generational wealth and community on Martha's Vineyard. But first, activism and political engagement have always been a part of the inner workings of black sororities and fraternities.

Get ready to “build a snowman” - Shayna Seymour is heading backstage and ON stage at Disney’s “Frozen,” presented by Broadway in Boston. Shayna takes us to the 17th floor at Boston’s newest luxury hotel, Raffles, for the view, drinks and eats.

More of what’s new, what’s happening, and what’s delicious! Shayna Seymour joins renowned Boston chef Tiffani Faison for a tour of Boston food hall, High Street Place, and heads to Cape Cod for an early-season visit to Pelham House Resort in Dennisport. Back in Boston Shayna roams around Dino Safari and checks out a new exhibit at the Museum of Fine Arts. Finally, Shayna gets her game on at Level 99 in Natick and meets a shop owner exerting plant power at Emerald City Plant Shop.

Tonight Shayna Seymour brings us more of what’s new, what’s happening, and where to do some holiday shopping! Shayna reports live from the Seaport Holiday Market, where she’ll check out the new layout and meet some of the market’s 120 vendors. Shayna also checks out a new pirate museum in Salem, tees it up at Puttshack Boston, and samples Italian dishes at Faccia a Faccia, the newest Boston eatery from restaurateurs Ken Oringer and Jamie Bissonette. Shayna also goes behind the scenes at KISS-108

Hungry? Shayna Seymour is stopping by Chef Dave’s, a new restaurant in Chestnut Hill. Sleepy? Shayna tests out the Cambria Hotel in Somerville. Looking for an activity? Shayna also hits the Beyond King Tut immersive exhibit, and at the Peabody Essex Museum, an exhibit featuring the work of a fashion designer Chronicle first met in Paris – 34 years ago! We bring it to you live from “Summer in the City” at the Boston Harbor Hotel. Shayna Seymour brings us a slew of summer discoveries.
Expecting mom Lacey does so much for her community but barely has time to take care of herself. Can Monica and friends create a serene, picture-perfect nursery in just 24 hours?
The latest news and weather from the WAPT 16 News team.
Chronicle gives us a look at how people outside of the state views Mississippi and how state leaders are working to change that image.
In Milwaukee, 19-year-old Sade Robinson has gone missing, and her car is found torched. A trail of evidence across the city shocks the community and leaves her family searching for justice.
World-renown maestro Edvard Tchievzel makes a harrowing escape from the USSR to bring his talent and skills to Greenville, where he leads the orchestra into a new era.

As a single mom, Nichole does it all – full-time job, full-time mom, and now it’s time for her to find a full-time boyfriend.  Three single guys will try to win her over with a cooking lesson, painting and wrapping it up with a smash.
Kate learns how to play a Germantown street game, gets up close and personal with handcrafted, hand-charred bourbon barrels,  and learns to fall back in love with whiskey – and natural wine.
Frank Nicotero faces off with a professional wrestler on the streets of New Orleans! Plus, he asks locals questions about a man with more than 2,000 Crocs and an unorthodox cologne.
From a dance instructor who prioritizes mental health for her students, to a high school baseball coach who exemplified courage, KC athletes show off their formulas for success.
Mardi Gras beading in New Orleans and a paper-folding artist in Austin.

On January 9, 2018, a massive debris flow tore through Montecito, becoming one of California’s deadliest natural disasters. But as families and first responders face unthinkable loss, stories of hope rise to unite this coastal community.

Every Christmas, the wealthy Sterlings gather at their remote estate to keep tradition alive. But when patriarch Harold Sterling is found poisoned after hinting at a shocking change to his will, buried secrets erupt. With the sheriff away, puzzle editor Vera Vexley and Deputy Neal race against time to unmask the killer among ambitious heirs, a loyal lawyer, and mysterious guests—before greed, lies, and betrayal claim another life.

Disillusioned workaholic Liza McCann and her son ravel to Christmas Town to visit her father, whom she hasn't seen in years. The city's profuse decorations and intense Yuletide spirit conspire to sweep her up in a series of inexplicable events, and now Liza is forced to rethink everything she thought was true.

As Christmas dinner preparations unravel, Lauren welcomes friends Megan, Paige, and lonely coworker Nora into her home. Through heartfelt stories of life-changing Christmases, they rediscover the power of kindness, authenticity, forgiveness, and chosen family. As her husband Tom finally arrives and dinner is served, Lauren realizes that the greatest holiday gifts aren't found under the tree, but in love, friendship, and second chances.

When Prancer injures his hoof Santa’s stable hand, John, must find a fill in to ensure Christmas deliveries go off without a hitch. His mission gets complicated when he discovers that Frankie, the perfect substitute reindeer, belongs to a precocious 8-year-old girl and her mother Annie. As he races to get Frankie up to the North Pole, he realizes that he’s actually falling in love with Annie and has to find a way to win her over and save Christmas at the same time.

Katrina Marks, author of �Just Say No to Ho, Ho, Ho,� plans to celebrate Christmas secretly after a tough year. She must evade Hunter Williams, a persistent TV reporter aiming to expose her, though she feels undeniable chemistry with him. Katrina joins �Christmas Lovers Anonymous� to indulge her Christmas spirit and meets a special guy. To her surprise, her online friend and Hunter share more in common than she realizes.

After leaving her Amish community in her youth, a New York book editor finds herself in desperate need of a new cookbook to save her job. With Christmas on the horizon Sarah heads back to her family farm to reconnect. But with the presence of a handsome local�an outsider, but one that is friendly with the Amish community�he and Sarah sense chemistry and work together to save her family�s Amish bakery (developing an Amish Christmas Cookbook in the process).

Christmas is special for Lori, but she�s overworked and underappreciated. When her boss demands she work over the holidays, she quits. Unsure of her future, she sees Patrick, a widowed firefighter, on a cooking show and feels a connection. Determined, Lori travels to his hometown, Hudson, Wisconsin, but loses hope seeing other women there for the same reason. Fate brings them together, but Lori hides her true intentions, fearing she might lose him when the truth comes out.

When lifestyle blogger Aubrey Lang visits the Danish-settled Californian village of Solvang for her big holiday piece, she at first believes the town is simply a tourist trap. But when Aubrey meets handsome community coordinator and chocolate shop owner Sawyer, to show her around town, Aubrey soon starts to fall for him and realizes the magic of Solvang's Christmas spirit shines year round.

Josie Jennings, a celebrated 35-year-old chef, heads home for the holidays to the magical bed-and-breakfast where she grew up, now home to her mother Shannon’s new restaurant. When famed critic Tanner Rhodes—who once gave Josie harsh reviews—arrives to judge her Christmas cuisine, old wounds resurface. As sparks ignite, Tanner must right his wrongs and prove he’s worthy of Josie’s love by Christmas Eve.

When single mom Erin brings her two young daughters to her estranged father’s Texas ranch for Christmas, old wounds resurface. Amid wide-open skies and holiday traditions, she meets charming local restaurateur Mateo. As sparks fly, Erin begins to heal her fractured relationship with her dad and discovers that forgiveness—and unexpected love—may be the greatest gifts waiting under the tree.

A real estate developer gets the chance of a lifetime to transform an old shopping complex into a luxury hotspot. But his plans hit a snag when the last holdout is the charming owner of a year-round Christmas shop—someone he unexpectedly connected with just days earlier. As he tries to win her over professionally, he finds himself falling for her and questioning everything he thought he wanted.

Life changes overnight for songwriting duo Brooke Remington and Chance Owens when NYC producer Rob Benson wants the demo Brooke submitted. But Rob wants Brooke solo. While dazzling her with dreams of stardom, Chance—secretly in love with Brooke—spirals. When Brooke discovers he once hid another big offer from her, she’s furious. Tensions rise until Chance fires her—only for Brooke to realize her heart’s with him, not the spotlight.

High-powered event planner Hayley Parker heads to the mountains for a quiet Christmas with her sister Amy, brother-in-law Tim, and his family—only to find Tim’s charming brother Paul is joining too. Hayley blames Paul for her last breakup and plans to keep her distance. But when Amy pleads for peace, Hayley agrees to play nice—only to discover there may be more to Paul than she thought.

The tables have turned in this follow up to the popular 2021 romcom MY BOSS’ WEDDING. Recently engaged Nicole and Michael have plans for a small, intimate wedding surrounded by family and friends but Nicole’s boss thinks this is the perfect opportunity to return the favor by taking over the wedding planning.  Will Nicole’s boss’ plans for a rushed and over-the-top wedding bring the couple closer together... or will it drive them apart?

When Chelsea Simms, the good-hearted brand strategist for the popular dating app The Nice List, discovers the app has granted her magical powers, she uses her newfound ability to make all of the �naughty� people in her life learn how to be good again. But when her plans go awry and Fisher, the kindly neighbor who has always carried a torch for Chelsea, is magically added to the naughty list by mistake, Chelsea must race against time to set things right before Christmas Eve.

programmes.t: The Case of the Christmas Diamond
programmes.d: When New York City lawyer Julia Crawley returns to her Rocky Mountain hometown and her family’s lovely inn for the holidays, she finds herself at the center of a generations-old feud with the family that runs the town’s other inn. As the ongoing competition between the two inns escalates, “forbidden” romance blossoms between Julia and Roger Mason, whose family runs the inn that is her family’s big competitor.

Cub reporter Sophia thinks she's found a Christmas story that will save her career when she discovers a long-lost, undelivered Secret Santa gift. Trying to uncover and bring closure to the overdue present before Christmas, Sophia discovers much more than she could have hoped for when she discovers that the gift is not only priceless but stolen.

When egotistical social media influencer DD Ward's dog is shockingly kidnapped, her long-suffering and under-appreciated assistant Emily forms an alliance with a down to earth local veterinarian to find the puppy before Christmas. As the two investigate all possible suspects, the duo form an unbreakable relationship that just might lead them to become more than partners as they find their own puppy love.

Sydney, a go-getting federal agent, finds out that her down-on-his luck confidential informant in a criminal investigation suddenly goes missing, she begins a desperate scramble to continue her investigation. However, her luck hasn’t run out yet when she finds a man who is her informant's mirror image. She recruits this doppelgänger to play his role.

Brooke and Roger, two graphic designers in a soon-to-be-merged company, help one another by agreeing to a loveless marriage of convenience, suggested by their new boss. In the process, Brooke gets to upstage the sister who just announced her engagement to Brooke's ex-boyfriend during the holidays. But, with their “marriage” in question, will Brooke and Roger find a spark they didn’t know existed?

With a Christmas deadline fast approaching, literary editor Isabell retreats to her family’s mountain cabin in search of inspiration for the story she can’t seem to finish. When she arrives, she discovers the once-charming town is struggling, its beloved Christmas Festival on the verge of being canceled. With the help of a kindhearted local rancher, Isabell sets out to revive the holiday spirit—and along the way, finds not only the heart of the town but also the perfect ending to her own story.

programmes.t: A Christmas Castle Proposal: A Royal In Paradise 2
programmes.d: Olivia meets charming Alexander on the tropical Haven Isles, unaware he’s a prince. As they explore the island, friendship turns to romance—until a royal spy reveals his identity. Invited to spend Christmas at his majestic palace, Olivia faces royal traditions, strict protocol, and comedic culture clashes. Amid the chaos, love is tested, but a magical Christmas might bring the proposal of a lifetime.

After a bad review Isabel is fired from her job as a successful pastry chef. Ready to start over she decides to open her own bakery in the small town of Shady Oaks. Struggling to adapt to the new area Isabel finds an old recipe book that brings inspiration back to her baking. When she discovers a secret code in the recipes Isabel sets out to solve a Christmas mystery.

Dae-gil, a young man with natural born talents in gambling, makes a dazzling debut as a gambler and gets reunited with his first love, Mi-na. However, Dae-gil soon becomes the scapegoat of betrayal and conspiracy and is forced to be on the run. Dae-gil plans to get revenge and prepares for one big, fated game for Mi-na who has been helping him every step of the way.

One of the admirals, Yamamoto Isoroku, disagrees. He recruits the upstart and mathematics' expert Tadashi Kai who discovers there are discrepancies between the official cost estimates and the actual figures. They soon find out that they have stumbled upon a conspiracy.

In the late Ming Dynasty, three sworn brothers who serve as the imperial secret police are dispatched to hunt down Wei Zhongxian, a eunuch politician who had been forced to resign from his influential post and exiled from Beijing. The brothers return successfully from their quest, only to find that their task was but the beginning of a strange conspiracy.

An imperial guard searches for the truth behind a conspiracy that framed him and his partners. The proof of his innocence lies with a wanted woman named Bei Zhai... but will she reveal what she knows? In this intense prequel to BROTHERHOOD OF BLADES, the only thing he can truly trust is his sword.
Still recovering from their abduction last Halloween, friends head back out on the road in search of the ultimate spooky experience.
When two priests investigate a miracle in an Irish home for unwed mothers in 1960, they discover that one of the residents is possessed by the devil.

It seems the notorious Kid the Phantom Thief has returned after eight years. At first, high school student and master illusionist Kaito seeks to challenge the magic trick-wielding outlaw out of pride, but then he learns that his deceased father was actually Kid the Phantom Thief, so who is the newcomer? Kaito puts on his dad's old cape, hat, and monocle and takes to the air to get answers.

Kaito finds himself double-booked when a theft he announced beforehand is on the same night as Aoko's birthday party. Complicating matters is the appearance of a group of jewel-collecting thugs who may have had something to do with the murder of Kaito's father.

Kaito goes up against a Syndicate-owned pool hall hustler to win back the Legendary Cue, a treasure once owned by Jii before he was cheated it out of it by the Syndicate boss many years ago. However, things look dire when Jii's pool hall is put on the line and Kaito apparently has no skill with the game.

Oga Tatsumi is a crazy-strong, ruthless high school delinquent who's nicknamed the "Rampaging Ogre". One day, while dunking some punk, he rescues a big guy who comes ~floating~ down the river. When he does, the big guy splits in half and out pops a bouncing baby boy! But this baby is actually Kaiser de Emperana Beelzebub IV (Baby Beel), the son of the Great Demon Lord, and he came from the Demon World in order to destroy humanity!

Oga has been chosen to be the parent of Beelzebub, the son of the Great Demon Lord. However Oga's suffering since every time Baby Beel cries he lets out a severe electric shock. Plus, according to Baby Beel's demon maidservant Hildegarde (Hilda), if Baby Beel moves farther than 15 meters away from his human parent Oga, the electric shock will reach lethal levels. Oga shuffles to school with Baby Beel clinging to his back, having no other choice, and begins to search for someone even stronger tha

Oga loses the powdered milk that Hilda prepared for him, and instead buys a bunch of "Yogurty" from a vending machine for Beel. But it turns out that's the favorite drink of one of Ishiyama's Big Four, the "Ishiyama Tohoshinki"; the third year Kanzaki Hajime. Oga hears about how horrible and ruthless a guy Kanzaki is, and runs into the third year classroom to try and dump Baby Beel off on him. When he sees Kanzaki's evil looking face, Oga thinks that this just might be his chance!

Kaguya, a beautiful woman, separately asks Lupin, Jigen and Goemon to gather the tears of the Yeti, a mermaid's scale, and the liver of a dragon so she can make a secret potion. Unaware that each of them has been given a task, they travel to the far corners of the earth to find these items. Will Kaguya's beloved prince awake from his sleep?

A wealthy shipping magnate and also a bachelor, Onabes' final voyage is nothing short of extravagant, with a ship full of beautiful women and fine art. Things go as planned when Lupin infiltrates the ship disguised as a woman, but things get complicated when Onabes falls in love and proposes to Lupin. Will Lady Lupin be walking down the aisle?

Those who have prepared to reclaim a nation find their plans exposed. The chaos multiplies after an assassin strikes down a mighty leader in broad daylight, and Alphonse falls prey to monsters in the dark.

A sinister voice rings out from the shell of Al's armor, and Ed and Greed find themselves under attack. As the Homunculi use the darkness to their advantage, a face from the past arrives to join the battle.

After investigating the twisted roots of the Bradley family tree, Mustang gathers his most loyal troops. Meanwhile, Ed and his allies continue fighting Selim, who shocks everyone by turning on his own kind.

programmes.t: Naruto the Movie: Ninja Clash in the Land of Snow [English Dub]
programmes.d: Naruto and his team are sent on a mission to guard Yukie Fujikaze, a popular actress starring in the hit movie "The Adventures of Princess Gale."

Sonic faces off against Dark Oak once again, Eggman has taken control of Blue Typhoon and outside the fortress are Metarex armada led by Red Pine. The situation can't seem to get any more dire when Red Pine and his crew begin to attack their own base.

As Amy wonders about fate of Shadow, the rest of the crew begin to fix things up around Blue Typhoon they come across a Chaotix ship who had been drifting in space since they last made their delivery to Chris.

Despite not knowing how it might affect Chris, the crew decide to travel through Intergalactic Cloister in hopes of reaching Metarex. The intense distortions inside the cloister knock everyone out inside the Cloister.

Ichiro Inuyashiki is a boring office worker who looks like an old man. Even after building them a new home, his family is nothing but ungrateful. One day, Inuyashiki is diagnosed with terminal cancer. Out on a walk to clear his head, a UFO crashes into him, and his body is rebuilt into a deadly robot. He steps in to stop a group of kids from torturing a homeless man when he is knocked unconscious.

Reborn a robot, Inuyashiki finds meaning by saving others. Meanwhile, high school student Hiro Shishigami has also been reborn a robot. Shishigami has no regard for anybody aside from his best friend and his family, and uses his robot powers to kill indiscriminately. Contrary to Inuyashiki, he feels alive when he is taking the lives of others. What happens when these two meet?

Shishigami is rattled to see Inuyashiki stand up from a blow that should have killed him before flying away. Seeing that, Inuyashiki knows that Shishigami has a robot body just like himself. After this meeting, Inuyashiki studies his abilities, and uses them to save others. Meanwhile, Shishigami confronts a group of delinquents who have been tormenting his best friend Naoyuki Ando.

A brilliant if arrogant teen detective comes to town, determined to capture Kid the Phantom Thief. This turns the heat up for Kaito, especially since they're classmates. In fact, Kaito becomes Suguru's rival even out of uniform, leading to a "gentlemen's bet" over which of them will go on a date with Aoko.

Kaito has a new classmate, Akako, who appears to possess genuine magic abilities, the kind that bend everyone to her will... except for Kaito and his alter ego, Kid the Phantom Thief! Who will come out on top in the inevitable showdown, sorceress or illusionist?

When Oga wakes up one morning, he's floating in a great pool of water... However it is actually Baby Beel's pee, as it is "urination season" right now in the Demon World. Oga is concerned about the entire city being inundated and humanity's imminent destruction, so he takes Baby Beel to the drug store to buy some disposable diapers. While he's there, a bunch of bank robbers a take Oga, Baby Beel, Hilda and Furuichi (who were chasing after him) as hostages.

On the back of Oga's fist a mark appears that is proof of his contract with the son of the Demon Lord, Beelzebub... The Zebul Spell. After hearing that the demonic power grows as well as the Zebul Spell the more he gets into fights and runs wild, Oga decides not to fight anymore to avoid that situation. However, Himekawa Tatsuya, heir to the Himekawa Zaibatsu and one of Ishiyama's TKKH like Kanzaki, is secretly plotting to do Oga in himself, and gives the command to his lackeys...

"A - Hilda brought back a bunch of toys from the Demon World for Baby Beel. When Oga and Hilda were assemble one, a horrible accident occurs! B - The Zebul Spell expands when one does evil. So won't it contract if you act like an angel? ...thinks Oga, who uses a Play Doctor toy with Beel as the doctor to try and heal patients. It's time to play Demon World Doctor!"

Lupin is in Hong Kong for a vacation when he is asked to find a woman in return for helping him escape from Inspector Zenigata. Lupin discovers the pickpocket who stole his wallet is the daughter of the woman he is looking for, and in her possession are the archeologically significant bones of the Peking Man. With Fujiko also after the Peking Man, will Lupin be able to add the bones to his private collection?

The Sleeping Lion, a statue made of solid gold, is being transported to a museum by a specially armored, airtight car to mark the 50th anniversary of Australia's independence. Lupin steals the armored car together with the statue out from under the Sydney Police's watchful eye, but then discovers that also inside the armored car is a nearly asphyxiated Inspector Zenigata. Will Lupin choose the golden statue over Inspector Zenigata's life?

With his father's help, Al takes incredible steps to contain the monstrous Pride. As the sun begins to rise on the Promised Day, the youngest Elric listens while the Homunculus ponders his very human mother.

Mustang leads a ragtag assault force of hardy northern troops - and welcome faces from the past - against Central's defenses. Victory seems certain until the military's most horrifying secret is revealed.

Ed's crew faces a horde of ravenous mannequins, abominations powered by human souls. The twisted creatures aren't the only unstoppable force on the battlefield - Pride, Sloth, and Envy are on the move.

Jun Pyo intends to expel his best friend and Jan Di out of Shinhwa High School -- and out of F4.
Jan Di dashes to the hospital after being informed that Jun Pyo had been in an accident.
Yi-jung gets a frantic call from his mother threatening to commit suicide because of his father.
Yi Jung's mother frantically calls him threatening to commit suicide.
A note indicates that class has been moved to the science lab. The lab is unoccupied, but Jan Di waits, not realizing that the room is filling with fumes.
Jan Di's father gets kidnapped by loan sharks, which inevitably forces Jan Di's mother to swallow her pride and plead for Madam Kang's help.
The F4 guys have moved on to college while Jan Di has entered her senior year of high school. She has not heard from Jun Pyo since he left.
Jan Di waits to hear the conclusions of F3's meeting with Jun-pyo, and can tell from their look that it was not good.
After treating Jan Di in a cruel manner, Mr. Jung prepares everything so that Jun-Pyo can visit her in Seoul. Will he be able to go without Madam Kang finding out?
Jan Di's family hears about Jun-pyo's engagement and asks her miserably if it's true.
Ji-hoo can see how hurt Jan Di is by the kiss, and continues to follow her as she stumbles around in shock.
Jun-pyo begins seeing Jae-Kyung in a new light, like he's seeing her for the first time as a potential friend -- or maybe a kindred spirit.
Woo-bin tries to talk some sense into Yi-jung, who is determined to drink himself into a stupor.
At home, Jun-hee reminisces about how her mother meddled in her life, in much the same way she's interfering in Jun-pyo's now.
Yi-jung is waiting outside for Eun-jae, excited to see her -- until he listens in on her phone conversation; from her words, it sounds like a call to a boyfriend.
Jun-pyo begs for Jan Di to advise him not to get married.
Jun-pyo tells Jan Di that he'll protect her, but to Jun-pyo's surprise, she says that she does not want to be cosseted or taken care of.
Aoi and Hazuka are classmates, but they are not friends. The two girls meet an elderly woman who wants to give a love letter to her first love. Hazuka and Aoi try to find her first love.
Perhaps feeling it's time to expose one truth, Mr. Jung leads Jun-hee to the unknown patient's bedside; at the sight of her father, Jun-hee breaks down.
Jun-pyo asks Yumi to make the lunchbox once more, confirming that Yumi had taken credit for her lunch.

The Dwarfers are now on probation and are trying their hardest to behave.
Nine years on and the Red Dwarf crew are older but still none the wiser.
Rimmer's replacement, Katerina, is determined to guide Lister back to his home planet.

programmes.t: Cesar Millan’s Leader of the Pack
programmes.d: A big and beautiful but unruly Labrador crossbreed needs a confident leader who can control his explosive, puppy-like energy and obsessive behavior and give him a home.
Cesar Millan comes to the rescue when Brad blows the whistle on his sister's Shibu Inu mix, a dog that has bitten members of its family and that some neighbors feel should be put down.

Cesar Millan is challenged by three barking bichon frises that are threatening the owner's business, then he heads to meet with The Freedom Writers, where a teacher struggles to provide leadership to her students.

programmes.t: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
programmes.d: Cesar helps a military veteran and his pack get back in order when his German shepherd mix, who helped him through his PTSD, has developed an unhealthy bond with him. And later, a young woman looks to Cesar for help when her dachshund puppy's dangerous habit of eating trash off the ground has put her in a life-threatening situation.

programmes.t: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
programmes.d: The Thompson pack is recovering from past trauma at the hands of an abusive ex-husband. Now, the women have suffered another tragedy: coonhound Nyla has become explosively aggressive, accidentally killing one family dog and viciously attacking another. Cesar needs to help the entire Thompson pack heal from past wounds and rehabilitate Nyla before the family is faced with a heartbreaking decision.

programmes.t: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
programmes.d: Cesar sets out to help a young couple's cantankerous Chihuahua, whose recent blindness makes him increasingly hostile to be around. And later, a family makes a desperate plea to Cesar to help them rein in their fast-growing and overexcited Belgian Malinois before he becomes too tough to tame.

programmes.t: Earth: The Nature of Our Planet
programmes.d: A miraculous mantle envelops the entire planet - a thin skin of gasses called 'air'. Without it, there would be no life or weather, no habitable conditions, or protection from lethal ultraviolet radiation or meteorites from outer space.

programmes.t: Earth: The Nature of Our Planet
programmes.d: It's the solid crust of our planet, the perfect element in which to record the stories of deep time and of lifetimes. Change and progression is the way of earth. Air and water turn solid rock into soil.

programmes.t: Earth: The Nature of Our Planet
programmes.d: How the flow of water has the power to shape all inhabitants on Earth, produces climate-changing weather and supporting species, from the largest whales to microscopic plankton.
Arid and unforgiving, deserts push their inhabitants to the extreme; from the desert elephant to the shovel-snouted lizard, see how they survive.
Rivers are the life veins of this planet, offering all those that depend on them respite from both heat and thirst; a look into how for the life they give, they also take away.

Africa's rainforests are second only to the Amazon in size; see these tangled worlds, that are home to chimpanzees, gorillas and forest elephants, one of the last remaining strongholds for the planet's wild creatures.

Africa's rainforests are second only to the Amazon in size; see these tangled worlds, that are home to chimpanzees, gorillas and forest elephants, one of the last remaining strongholds for the planet's wild creatures.

programmes.t: Earth: The Nature of Our Planet
programmes.d: A miraculous mantle envelops the entire planet - a thin skin of gasses called 'air'. Without it, there would be no life or weather, no habitable conditions, or protection from lethal ultraviolet radiation or meteorites from outer space.

programmes.t: Earth: The Nature of Our Planet
programmes.d: It's the solid crust of our planet, the perfect element in which to record the stories of deep time and of lifetimes. Change and progression is the way of earth. Air and water turn solid rock into soil.

programmes.t: Earth: The Nature of Our Planet
programmes.d: How the flow of water has the power to shape all inhabitants on Earth, produces climate-changing weather and supporting species, from the largest whales to microscopic plankton.

A blossoming romance between a vampire and a human is endangered by an unexpected visit.
After Earth has suffered an alien invasion a journalist escort an American tourist through an infected zone.
When a beautiful young influencer survives a mysterious shark attack, she becomes a monstrous apex predator, hunting and feeding in sunny Venice beach, California.
A mystical woman must save her village from invaders, but the entity she conjures to protect them is a far greater evil.
A blackout causes a city's population to vanish. A handful of survivors realize they escape the darkness.

After finding a gruesomely slaughtered family just outside Amsterdam, the police calls veterinarian Lizzy for help. She finds herself leading the city-wide hunt for a monstrous lion terrorizing the Dutch capital in this grisly adventure.
Trapped in a gas station by a parasite, a couple and an escaped convict must find a way to survive.
A horror's author's stories come to life when read out loud.
A mermaid is ripped from the Pacific, her tail is chopped off and she's thrown into a mental home where no one believes she is a mermaid.

Dr. Rich Freeman (Tony Award winner Santino Fontana), an ambitious and well-liked psychology professor, pursues a sleep study with a focus on nightmares, dreams, and sleep paralysis -- the success of which would result in a lucrative grant. As the line between dreams and reality blur, a member of the study is murdered, and everything begins to unravel, leaving Rich fighting to make things right.
Some say Bigfoot is just a hoax, but when a group of hikers go deep into the woods after being warned by a guide that has encountered a Sasquatch, they begin to realize that they are not alone...

A family sequesters themselves in a high-rise apartment after the mysterious death of their daughter Lilith. Haunted by their past, the survivor's lies, deceits and strange behavior will have you asking: who killed Lilith and who will be next?

Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as Lyon Gaultier, a member of the French Foreign Legion who deserts his post in order to come to America and help the family of his murdered brother. But crossing the U.S. without a penny to his name proves difficult. Lyon then takes up the sport of bare-knuckle fighting, earning him the money to reach his destination and support his loved ones -- but with the Foreign Legion hot on his trail, will he ever find peace?
A ghostly presence and a lawyer come between four young siblings. They must stand together or be torn apart.
Settlers traveling through the Oregon desert in 1845 find themselves stranded in harsh conditions.
After Earth has suffered an alien invasion a journalist escort an American tourist through an infected zone.
Three radical environmentalists look to execute the protest of their lives: the explosion of a hydroelectric dam.

Janis, a child Cello prodigy, has struggled in her adult life with a split personality disorder and has willingly yielded to the control of her husband/therapist who, with the excuse of striving for her cure, has manipulated her all along through medication and psychological torture. He keeps her virtually imprisoned at his home in an isolated island where she spends her life fighting a never-ending battle inside her multiple personalities.
A jilted fan soon finds himself pulled into a deadly game of cat-and-mouse after he accepts the opportunity to spy on his favorite actress via his laptop.

In the hazy aftermath of an unimaginable loss, couple Sarah (Olivia Wilde) and Phil (Luke Wilson) come unhinged, recklessly ignoring the repercussions. Featuring Giovanni Ribisi, Elisabeth Moss, Ty Simpkins and John Leguizamo.
A high school English teacher goes to disturbing lengths to protect his favorite students from bullies.
A teen's murder shakes a Nevada community, especially when two unlikely people make confessions.
Intruders break into a family's home.

Kathleen Schroll makes a phone call right before her death where she identifies her killer, which leads to an arrest. Two trials and 12 years later, authorities begin to wonder who was really the victim.
A community is left in shock when a Cornell student and star athlete gets caught in the middle of a homicide investigation.
After filming wraps on an indie horror movie, the cast members learn their lead actress is not who she says she is and has been charged with killing her uncle.
A foreign exchange student and soccer player's participation in a dangerous game leads to deadly consequences.

When a soldier vanishes from Fort Hood, her family do everything they can to bring attention to her disappearance; Secretary of the Army Ryan McCarthy speaks about the investigation and allegations of sexual assault in the military.
A young father in California calls 911 after being in a shootout in a car full of strangers that injures two people and kills another.
Police investigate when the seemingly storybook romance between a football player and the homecoming queen ends in a death.

The investigation into the death of a woman whose remains were found in her Frisco, Texas, garage leads detectives to a series of suspects with connections to the victim's complicated and secretive life.
A man is shot and killed while picking up his daughter for a court-ordered visit.
An Air Force captain is shot dead leaving police to suspect his wife and her Army sharpshooter lover.
The investigation into the death of a Florida firefighter reveals a tale of secrets, lies and infidelity.
A Kentucky man is convicted of murdering his co-worker; the mystery is considered solved until a stunning disclosure years later turns the closed case upside down.
A pilot flees following a plane crash, becomes a fugitive and lives a double life for decades.
Brittany Stork's decades-long quest to find out more about her mother's mysterious death leads to a dramatic courtroom decision; the man at the center of the case tells his side of the story.
The mystery of a successful real estate entrepreneur killed by a car bomb spans nearly two decades.
A tale of sex, betrayal and murder: Inside the deadly love triangle where three became a crowd.
The trial and murder conviction of Jodi Arias and the salacious relationship that ended in tragedy.
A 29-year-old woman goes missing.
A man dies in a shooting incident after tempers flare in a confrontation in Montana's Glacier National Park.
The family members of murdered California entrepreneur Chris Smith speak out; interviews with investigators, Smith's former colleague, and prosecutor Matt Murphy.
A dancer is murdered in her Virginia home; after interviewing a series of suspects, detectives realize the case is much more complicated than previously thought.
When an Iowa woman is attacked while home alone with her three children, the confrontation turns deadly.
Lester Holt reports on the mysterious 2005 disappearance of Ray Gricar, a district attorney in Pennsylvania who investigated sex-abuse claims made against Jerry Sandusky in 1998.
The investigation into a newlywed's disappearance focuses on her job as a CIA employee as a possible clue.

After trumpet player Scott Sessions fails to show up for a scheduled gig, his family learns his body was abandoned in the remote Colorado Rockies; as the investigation narrows in on two suspects, a second murder catches police by surprise.

Rob's talented, sleepwalking brother manages to audition successfully for The Alan Brady Show.
Buddy laments the decline of the American male and yearns for the good old days.
Rob faces a dilemma when an old army pal must be told he cannot attend a special dinner party.
Rob tries to help an old radio comedy writer make a comeback.
Ritchie adopts two baby ducks and Rob faces the task of making him understand the consequences.
Rob disguises his voice and asks Laura on a date.
Rob recalls his and Laura's attempts to get married when Ritchie brings up the subject.
Rob is puzzled when he discovers Laura's secret bank account.
A hypnotist visits a Petrie dinner party where Rob accidentally picks up a post-hypnotic suggestion.
Rob has some explaining to do when son Ritchie learns that his middle name is Rosebud.
Rob grows increasingly concerned that Sally is falling for Ric Vallone.
Long day causes a spat between Petries.
Rob suspects that Buddy and Sally may be moonlighting for another comedy show or having an affair.
Ritchie claims he keeps being attacked by a giant woodpecker.
Rob fears he is allergic to his family.
Rob feels that he has betrayed his dentist friend when he lets another dentist work on his teeth.
While directing the annual variety show, Rob becomes frustrated by spousal jealousies.
After a string of burglaries in the neighborhood, the Petrie home is pillaged.
Laura believes her marriage is threatened by a singing weather girl.
Rob recounts the wrath he encountered when he broke his engagement with his hometown sweetheart.
Rob describes Laura as a "nut" on TV.
Rob leaves the show after Mel rejects his script and is upset when Buddy and Sally don't join him.
Rob fears a walnut will steal his imagination. Guest: Danny Thomas.
Laura tries to break Rob of his expensive habit of picking up the check.
Rob ignores Laura's warning to stay off the big slopes on his first skiing trip.
The Petries hire a painter who ends up painting much more than just their living room.
Rob, Laura and the office gang put together a variety show to help out an old friend.
Jacques Savon, who has played a curious part in both Rob's and Laura's pasts, suddenly reappears.
Rob finds himself very out of place at a dinner party for celebrated literati.
A romantic British film star (Richard Dawson) arouses Rob's ire by his attentions to Laura.
Rob finds himself caught in the middle after Buddy announces he is going to divorce Pickles.
Laura's old flame re-enters the Petries' lives as Alan Brady's newest sponsor.
Laura despairs when Rob learns of her elaborate plans to throw a surprise party for him.
Sally gets a marriage proposal from an opportunistic comedian who wants her to write his material.
Rob finds himself in hot water after inadvertently lifting a comedy idea from another show.
Rob reminisces about the joy and uneasiness of the day Ritchie was born.
Rob bids on and wins an ugly clown painting that covers another work beneath, perhaps a masterpiece.
Rob would like to know why Laura disappears every time his insurance agent comes over or calls.
Rob and Laura, having learned they are not legally married, make plans to elope.
Rob and Laura unintentionally eavesdrop on the Helpers prior to attending their dinner party.
Rob finds himself trapped between casting Laura as this year's leading woman or a talented newcomer.
Rob finds himself at a party in a strange town, dancing with a young woman.
Rob's energetic Uncle George comes for a visit to eagerly pressure Rob into finding him a wife.
A man with suspected underworld connections asks Rob, Sally and Buddy to write a comedy routine.
Rob and Jerry's friendship is sorely tested when they buy a boat together.
Rob feels very much the hero when he hires a maid for his overworked wife, Laura.
Rob struggles between his civic duty and fear for his family's safety.
The entire "Alan Brady" staff presents a Christmas show instead of the script.
A young chorus girl on The Alan Brady Show falls desperately in love with Rob.
Rob finds himself in trouble when Laura interferes with an interview he is giving on Alan Brady.
When a handsome bachelor moves in next door, Rob and Laura become matchmakers.
Rob is overwhelmed by jealousy when he meets one of Laura's old flames.
A social game of poker turns sour when it's discovered Rob has been playing with a marked deck.
Laura and Rob give Ritchie a birthday party and 63 screaming moppets make a shambles of their house.
Rob consults a psychiatrist to determine whether a series of mysterious ailments is psychosomatic.

Once extinct, species can never come back-until now. Scientists use cutting-edge genetics to revive extinct species, raising ethical questions about humanity's role in nature's balance.

The frozen Arctic sea isn't just white, the ice glows green with life as algae bloom and sustain vast ecosystems beneath its surface; scientists explore this hidden layer of polar biodiversity and discover what it reveals.

In Chile's Torres del Paine, melt from snow-covered mountains feeds finger-like fjords as they reach out to the sea to join the current, lowering its salinity and becoming home to wading birds, rare dolphins and orcas.
As we follow our female blue whale north, we arrive in central Chile; the influence of the Humboldt current shapes life even in one of the driest ecosystems on earth.
The current is followed by a unique population of Chilean blue whales and is the last refuge for other extremely rare marine mammals.

At the meeting point of river and ocean, witness the power of nature's forces as climate change alters the landscape-and the people-of the Amazon delta.

A sensual alien seduces men to obtain a weapon of mass destruction; Crichton experiences mental flashes of the future.
For trade with the Tavleks, Rygel (John Eccleston, Jonathan Hardy) takes a crystal essential to Moya's survival.
Crichton and a female Peacekeeper Tech, left behind by Captain Crais, join forces to save Moya when a race of scavengers attacks.
Crichton must free D'Argo from the influence of a thought-altering plant.
Moya crash-lands on a planet to avoid being traced by the Peacekeepers; Crichton soon realizes that he has become an alien to the inhabitants.
When an evil sorcerer engineers a deadly contest between Crichton and Crais, Zhaan must rouse a dark power within herself to rescue Crichton.
When the crew seeks out a genetic scientist who can provide them with charts to their homeworlds, the scientist secretly injects Aeryn with Pilot's DNA.
After D'Argo suffers a mishap during a maintenance check on Moya, he is tormented by flashbacks; the ship strikes out at the crew.
While gathering data to re-create a wormhole, Crichton and Aeryn are confronted by wolflike bounty hunters in search of Moya's crew.
An invisible net controlled by Zenetan pirates captures Crichton and Aeryn's transport pod and threatens to snare the Moya as well.
When Zhaan tries to aid in curing Tahleen's madness, Tahleen betrays her and reveals Zhaan's dark side.
Crichton stumbles upon the planet of Acquara, an Earth-like paradise where no mechanical devices seem to function after landing.
Mental cleansing changes a Peacekeeper, who once tormented Rygel, into a servile being; with Ben Browder, Gigi Edgley and Tiriel Mora.
Crichton travels through a wormhole that greatly affects Earth, where the entire crew is subjected to intense testing and imprisonment.
Moya tries to starburst to prove to the crew that she still can; it goes slightly wrong though and she gets stuck in starburst, and splits into several different dimensions.
Peacekeeper commandos board the ship after a fuel leak and join the Moya's crew in battle against a deadly virus.
Crichton must infiltrate a Peacekeeper base to save Aeryn's life, but ends up facing torture in an alien electric chair and archenemy Crais.
The crew of the Moya tries to save Crichton from the hands of Crais and the Peacekeepers; with Gigi Edgley and Wayne Pygram.
Moya and her unsuspecting crew encounter a carnivorous alien.

With death approaching in the form of Peacekeeper search parties, those aboard Moya say their final goodbyes and share a last feast together, before enacting a plan to save Moya and her baby, named Talyn.
Crichton, Aeryn and D'argo are stranded in an asteroid field while Scorpius searches for them; their safety depends on Crais, who is nearby in Talyn.

D'Argo takes part in a sacred ritual that helps an old Luxan, an Orican, to survive; during the ritual the Orican draws energy from who she thinks is D'Argo but is actually Moya; consequently Moya starts to age rapidly.
Chiana joins a group of nihilistic teenagers on a cemetery planet.
An alien boards Moya, deranging the crew.
Chiana discovers a recording with Moya's original Pilot; after seeing the recording and realizing Aeryn was involved, Pilot orders Aeryn to leave Moya.
A fortunetelling portrait acquired from a passing trader turns out to be the tool of an old enemy. With Ben Browder.
Crichton and the crew desperately search for food to nurse an ailing friend back to health, but they may have to sacrifice a friend to save one.
Zhaan, Chiana and Rygel come to grips with the apparent deaths of Crichton, Aeryn and D'Argo.
After an enemy ship fires on Moya, crew members find that their personalities have been switched. With Ben Browder.
Contact with a mysterious light source creates three separate Crichtons from different rungs of the evolutionary ladder.
Moya and her crew land on a planet just in time to celebrate the coronation of a new royal couple, but there is a catch -- the princess has not found her prince.
A quick turn of events sees Crichton chosen as the unwilling groom-to-be in the upcoming royal wedding.
Someone removes Crichton's head from a statue; Aeryn examines her choices; Zhaan faces a Moya builder.
A crew member falls prey to a shape-shifting parasite and the rest of the crew must locate it before it is too late.
Crichton becomes a mental slave on a commerce planet and must trust his greatest enemy, Scorpius, to help him see the truth through the illusions.
The crew races to save Crichton after contact with a hyper stream of time speeds up his aging process.
Talyn destroys a Plokavian ship, leading to the capture of the crew.
Chiana's unknowing part in the Nebari scheme to control a portion of the galaxy is revealed after they take over the Moya.
Stark plans to rob a less-than-reputable bank to get them money for a sizable purchase of slaves, but things don't quite go the way he thinks they will.
Infected currency from the Shadow Depository threatens the crew of the Moya as they decide how best to rescue D'Argo's son.
The crew of the injured Moya must rely on the help of disorganized mercenaries to save Crichton from Scorpius.
An alien surgeon comes to the aid of Crichton, removing the control chip from his head and healing the Moya.
The Moya's crew must quickly recover from their last adventure because Scorpius is up to his old tricks.
